多智能体系统

[MA-0] Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统中个体能力与集体协调机制分离导致的协同效率低下问题，即传统方法通常在固定架构下分别训练智能体的行为策略与组织结构，难以实现动态适应。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于市场的后训练（Market-based Post-training, MPT）框架，使去中心化智能体群体能够在无需中央协调者的情况下，联合学习动作策略与自组织参与机制。具体而言，智能体通过出价表达参与意愿，出价结果决定行动主体，同时集体成果为个体提供局部训练信用。这种联合学习机制使得个体能力与参与模式能够协同演化，显著提升了系统的可扩展性、鲁棒性与任务迁移能力。实验表明，采用相同后训练动作策略时，学习到的自组织机制优于其他协调策略，且在面对智能体失效或群体规模扩大时表现更优，验证了所提方法在实际应用中的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22322
作者: Guowei Xu,Zhenting Qi,Amani Kiruga,Himabindu Lakkaraju,Yilun Du
机构: Harvard University(哈佛大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The capabilities of an agent swarm depend on both its individual members and how they coordinate. Yet existing multi-agent systems often train agents within fixed orchestration structures, separating the learning of individual capabilities from the organization of collective behavior. We introduce market-based post-training (MPT), a framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Agents express their willingness to participate through bids, which determine who acts and how collective outcomes provide local training credit. Learning both action and bidding behavior allows individual capabilities and patterns of participation to adapt together without a central coordinating agent. We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Results show gains over monolithic post-training and confirm that agent participation indeed evolves with learning. With the same post-trained action policies, learned self-orchestration outperforms alternative coordination strategies. Ablations show that both action and bidding benefit from learning, and that learned bids provide more effective action-training signals. Beyond the original training objectives, trained swarms adapt faster to related tasks and achieve better performance with larger populations at inference time. Larger populations also suffer smaller performance losses under agent dropout, demonstrating that learned self-orchestration supports reuse, scaling, and robustness in decentralized agent swarms. Code and trained models are available at this https URL.

[MA-1] Learning to Steer LLM Agents and Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）驱动的智能体及多智能体系统在执行长时程任务过程中出现的目标漂移（goal drift）问题。目标漂移表现为系统在执行过程中逐渐偏离原始任务目标，导致资源浪费与错误结果。为应对这一挑战，论文提出一种动态引导智能体（steering agent），通过实时观测执行上下文，在检测到漂移时以低成本的快速路径（fast path）决定是否干预，并以高成本的慢速路径（slow path）生成有效修正策略。其核心解决方案在于采用强化学习联合训练双路径机制，结合成对排序目标与组相对策略优化（Group-Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO），从而赋予引导智能体评估目标漂移并生成高效干预措施的能力。实验表明，该方法显著提升了单智能体与多智能体系统在信息检索类任务中的性能与效率，且所学得的引导能力具备良好的跨领域泛化性、对未见执行器的迁移能力以及无需重训练即可调节干预频率的可控性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22316
作者: Leyang Shen,Yaxin Gong,Yang Zhang,Chenxiao Fan,Jiakai Wang,Dong Wang,Yang Liu,Fuli Feng,Chun Kai Ling,Tat-Seng Chua
机构: National University of Singapore(新加坡国立大学); University of Science and Technology of China(中国科学技术大学); Qwen Business Unit of Alibaba(阿里巴巴通义业务部)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 21 pages, 6 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use and inter-agent collaboration. However, these systems are prone to deviating from the overall goal as execution unfolds, which wastes execution resources and leads to undesired outcomes, a failure termed goal drift. In this work, we propose a steering agent that supervises execution on the fly and steers the system back on track when drift occurs. The steering agent observes the execution context, deciding when to intervene with a low-cost fast path and how to intervene with a high-cost slow path. To unlock its steering intelligence, the ability to assess goal drift and generate effective interventions, we jointly train the two paths with reinforcement learning, combining a pairwise ranking objective with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). Experiments on information-seeking search tasks show that the steering agent provides effective supervision for both single-agent and multi-agent systems, improving their performance and efficiency. The learned steering intelligence generalizes to out-of-domain tasks, transfers to unseen executors, and supports controllable intervention frequency without retraining.

[MA-2] Learning Rational Strategies for Temporal Objectives in Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决未知动态的随机多智能体系统中基于理性合成（rational synthesis）的问题，其核心挑战在于如何在满足各智能体特定概率时序目标的前提下，设计出符合博弈论解概念（如纳什均衡、子博弈完美均衡）的稳定联合策略。每个智能体的目标以有限轨迹上的概率线性时序逻辑（Probabilistic Linear Temporal Logic on Finite Traces, PLTL_f）形式给出，而策略优化则依赖于从各智能体满足其时序目标的概率所导出的收益。解决方案的关键在于将理性合成问题形式化为：寻找一个联合策略（若存在），使得（i）指定智能体的时序约束被满足，且（ii）该策略在选定解概念下具有战略稳定性。为此，研究提出了基于表格型纳什Q学习的条件收敛保证，并结合同时性的有限样本置信区间来验证目标满足性，通过近似最优响应检验评估策略稳定性。整个方法运行于无模型的多智能体强化学习（Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning, MARL）框架中，利用奖励自动机自动编译时序目标为奖励信号，从而实现对时序目标极值满足概率的自主学习。实验在8个一般和博弈（general-sum concurrent stochastic games）中进行了验证，证明了方法的有效性与可扩展性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22287
作者: Omar Adalat,Edwin Hamel-De le Court,Francesco Belardinelli
机构: Imperial College London(帝国理工学院); University of Manchester(曼彻斯特大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Logic in Computer Science (cs.LO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study rational synthesis for stochastic multi-agent systems with unknown dynamics, where each agent is equipped with its own probabilistic temporal objective specified using Probabilistic Linear Temporal Logic on Finite Traces ( \mathsfPLTL_f ). We impose solution concepts (e.g., Nash equilibrium, subgame-perfect equilibrium) as constraints on the joint strategy profile, using payoffs derived from each agent’s probability of satisfying its temporal objective. In particular, we formulate per-agent rational synthesis as finding a strategy profile – if one exists – such that (i) the designated agent’s probabilistic temporal constraint is satisfied, and (ii) the profile represents a stable solution under a chosen solution concept. We give conditional convergence guarantees for tabular Nash-Q learning, certify satisfaction with simultaneous finite-sample confidence bounds, and assess strategic stability with approximate best-response checking. Our approach operates in a stochastic \emphMulti-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) environment, where model-free learning algorithms attempt to attain extremal satisfaction probabilities for temporal objectives automatically compiled into reward automata. Our approach is empirically validated using 8 general-sum concurrent stochastic games.

[MA-3] Auditable and Deployable Multi-Agent Motion Planning via Posetal Games from Legal Guidelines

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统在现实世界部署中如何在遵守法律约束的前提下，协同完成各自目标的问题。传统方法依赖标量化的目标函数或完全指定的优先级层次结构，难以处理法律要求与个体目标之间部分冲突且优先级不明确的情形。为此，论文提出基于部分有序偏好博弈（posetal games）的多智能体运动规划框架，通过独立于具体场景的法律准则，自动推导出适用于特定场景的代理偏好与法律博弈模型。其核心创新在于：法律准则可随法规演进而更新，代理也可结合私有目标对法律偏好进行细化；理论证明此类自定义仅会移除均衡点，从而确保结果始终合法。为实现无需共享私有偏好的协调，引入信念博弈（belief play）机制，可从保守的局部博弈中精确恢复真实均衡，并设计分布式迭代最优响应协议以降低信息交换需求。研究将该框架应用于海上航行场景，将成对交通规则系统性扩展至多船相遇情形，在七组含最多四艘船舶的测试中，所有承诺均衡中的违规行为均被证明是法律层级强制或不可满足所致，且所有偏离者均可仅依据公开信息识别。结果表明，基于准则的posetal博弈为从部分指定的法律规范到多智能体运动规划提供了可审计的解决方案。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22277
作者: Florian Lercher,Karan Mahesh,Yujun Huang,Meshal Alharbi,Runyu Zhang,Hanna Krasowski,Michael R. Benjamin,Matthias Althoff,Gioele Zardini
机构: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (麻省理工学院); Technical University of Munich (慕尼黑工业大学); Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution (伍兹霍尔海洋研究所); University of California, Berkeley (加州大学伯克利分校)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Robotics (cs.RO); Systems and Control (eess.SY)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When robots are deployed in the real-world, they must interact with other agents and accomplish their own goals while adhering to legal constraints. These potentially conflicting objectives are often only partially prioritized, making scalarized objectives or fully specified hierarchies unsuitable. We present a framework for multi-agent motion planning under legal requirements based on games with partially ordered preferences (posetal games). Scenario-independent legal guidelines order abstract legal concerns, from which we automatically derive agent preferences and a legal game for any concrete scenario. Agents may refine their legal preferences with private objectives, and regulators may refine the guideline as laws evolve. We prove that such customizations can only remove equilibria and thus preserve legality. To coordinate agents without explicitly communicating private preferences, we introduce belief play, which provably recovers the true equilibria from conservative local games, and a distributed iterative best-response protocol requiring less information. We apply the framework to maritime navigation, systematically lifting pairwise traffic rules to multi-vessel encounters. On seven encounters with up to four vessels, every rule violation of the committed equilibria is certified as forced by the legal hierarchy or unsatisfiable, and defectors are identified from public information in all tested cases. These results indicate that guideline-based posetal games offer an auditable route from partially specified laws to multi-agent motion planning.

[MA-4] Decentralized LLM Workflows via Sequential Auctions

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多步任务求解中因市场机制设计不当而导致的协作失效问题，特别是如何在缺乏完美竞争（即完全同质化代理）的前提下，维持一个高效且可持续的分布式代理市场。其核心挑战在于：一方面，若存在完全同质化的“完美克隆”代理（perfect clones），虽可实现全局最优策略收敛，但会因利润归零而瓦解参与者的风险-收益激励机制；另一方面，若完全缺乏竞争，则导致市场失灵与价值提取崩溃。为应对这一矛盾，论文提出通过引入异构代理（heterogeneous agents）在不完全竞争（imperfect competition）的中间地带实现系统稳定运行。解决方案的关键在于设计具备策略性出价能力的代理学习机制——代理需通过合理“压价”（strategic shading of bids）以保留正向个体利润边际，同时确保整体市场仍能有效协调资源完成消费者提出的协同任务。研究评估了四种出价算法（镜像下降、汤普森采样、贝叶斯最优及PPO）在三种拍卖协议（第一价格、第二价格、信用保存维克里拍卖）下的表现，结果表明，在多样化任务场景中，不完全竞争机制既能保障代理的可持续盈利，又能在低开销下实现高任务成功率，从而在效率与激励相容之间达成平衡。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22201
作者: Ian Gemp,Shubhendu Trivedi,Adam Fisch,Fantine Huot,Michael Kaisers,Mirella Lapata,William W. Cohen,Alekh Agarwal,Kate Larson,Jacob Eisenstein
机构: Google DeepMind(谷歌深度思维); Google Research(谷歌研究); University of Waterloo(滑铁卢大学)
类目: Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 28 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We present a scalable framework for solving multi-step tasks through a decentralized market of self-interested agents. Prior theoretical work demonstrated that agents organized through sequential auctions can converge to a globally optimal policy in a Markov decision process (MDP), but relied on the restrictive assumption of the existence of perfect clones as a model of perfect competition. In reality, exact clones drive agent profit to zero, violating the natural risk-reward incentives of participants. Conversely, we empirically demonstrate that the opposite extreme, absence of competition, also leads to market failure and value extraction collapse. Between these two extremes, we investigate how heterogeneous agents can survive in markets that span the critical middle ground of imperfect competition. To be profitable, agents learn to strategically shade bids to secure positive individual profit margins, while still ensuring that the marketplace functions effectively enough so that collaborative tasks posed by market consumers can still be solved. We formulate and evaluate four bidding algorithms (Mirror Descent, Thompson Sampling, Bayes-Optimal, and PPO) across three auction protocols (1st-Price, 2nd-Price, and Credit-Conserving Vickrey). Across a diverse set of domains, we demonstrate that imperfect competition successfully sustains necessary agent profit margins while maintaining high task success rates at low costs.

[MA-5] Robust Multi-Agent Pursuit with Preemptive Communication via Reachability-Based Control Barrier Functions

【速读】：该论文旨在解决资源受限的真实机器人系统在多智能体协同中面临的安全控制与通信约束之间的矛盾问题，即现有安全协同方法通常依赖于连续且完美的状态共享，而实际部署的机器人由于计算、通信等资源限制难以实现。其核心挑战在于：在间歇性通信条件下如何保证多智能体间的碰撞规避。解决方案的关键在于提出一种统一的控制/通信协同策略，通过引入基于控制屏障函数（Control Barrier Functions, CBF） 的安全控制机制，使每个智能体仅依据最后一次接收到的邻近智能体状态信息，实时计算其可达集（reachable set），并据此生成满足安全约束的控制输入，从而确保在通信延迟或中断时仍能避免碰撞。同时，该方案设计了新颖的不确定性风险与运动学风险度量指标，用于判断何时应主动提前发送状态信息以降低潜在碰撞风险。理论证明表明，只要通信延迟保持有界，智能体间即可保证无碰撞。仿真结果验证了该方法在追逃场景中的有效性，相较于周期性和事件触发式通信基线，可减少77.5%的消息传输量且零碰撞。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22198
作者: Madison Book,Justin Bradley
机构: NC State University (北卡罗来纳州立大学)
类目: ystems and Control (eess.SY); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Robotics (cs.RO)
备注: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Safe multi-agent coordination typically assumes what real-world, deployed, resource-constrained robots cannot provide: continuous, perfect state sharing. Robust control strategies must be complemented with robust communication strategies to deliver resilient deployments. In this work, we propose a unified control/communication strategy that provides safe control to guarantee inter-agent safety under intermittent communication and demonstrate its effectiveness in a pursuit-evasion scenario. Each agent computes the reachable set of neighboring agents based on the last state information received, then solves for a safe control input based on control barrier functions to ensure agents avoid collision. We prove that inter-agent collision avoidance is guaranteed provided communication staleness remains bounded. As the reachable set inflates between state transmissions, each agent reasons about when to preemptively transmit its state information to neighboring agents based on novel metrics characterizing uncertainty risk and kinematic risk. We implement and simulate a variety of pursuit-evasion scenarios and show that preemptive communication reduces messages by 77.5% compared to periodic and event-triggered baselines with zero collisions.

[MA-6] Believed but Not Said: Measuring Hidden Belief Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Discussions

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）系统中多智能体协作机制的可靠性问题，即在依赖智能体间相互讨论、批判与验证以纠正个体错误的设定下，当存在恶意干扰时，群体决策是否仍能保持正确性。其核心问题是：在存在少数具有误导性的对抗性智能体（adversarial agents）的情况下，群体共识是否会受到不可见但广泛传播的隐性影响，从而导致错误信息被普遍接受。解决方案的关键在于通过设计一种最小对抗实验范式，将真实答案与公开立场分离进行探测——即对每个良性智能体进行独立私密询问以获取其真实信念，同时记录其在群体讨论中的公开表态。研究发现，尽管公开立场显示仅有约20%的良性智能体支持错误答案，但私密回答揭示高达51.6%的智能体实际上已内化错误认知，表明对抗性影响主要以隐蔽方式渗透，且错误观点一旦被采纳便迅速扩散，而基础知识水平无法有效预测智能体的抗干扰能力。这一结果挑战了传统关于从众行为仅体现为公开表态趋同的认知，揭示了群体讨论中“表面一致”下的深层认知偏差，凸显了当前多智能体系统在对抗环境下缺乏透明度与鲁棒性的根本缺陷。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22138
作者: Liangjie Huang,Henry Peng Zou,Wei-Chieh Huang,Wooseong Yang,Yuwei Han,Philip S. Yu
机构: University of Illinois Chicago (伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 14 pages, 6 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM systems increasingly rely on groups of agents that discuss, critique, and check one another, assuming that peers will catch individual errors. We test this assumption against a minimal adversary. In a ten-agent factual discussion, one or three adversarial agents repeatedly assert a plausible false answer. After each round we probe each benign agent’s private answer through a separate call whose response is hidden from its peers, and we separately label its public stance toward the claim. Across six models and three factual-QA datasets, groups remain stable without an attacker: only 0.6% of benign agents finish with the false answer. A single adversarial agent increases this rate to 44.8% and three to 60.5%. Studies of conformity typically report public agreement without private change; we find the reverse. With three adversarial agents present, benign agents hold the false answer in 51.6% of exposed turns but publicly endorse it in only 19.7%. Much of the influence therefore remains invisible in the discussion, and the false answers persist when agents are asked for their own views. Agents that retain the true answer often fail to defend it; once adopted, the false answer spreads among benign agents, and baseline knowledge does not predict robustness.

[MA-7] Agent ic-Priors: Using Large Language Models to Address the Cold Start Problem in Preference Elicitation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决智能代理在学习用户偏好时面临的“冷启动”问题：在未观察到任何用户选择行为之前，代理必须依赖先验信息，而传统上用于构建先验的、基于历史选择数据的方法在新任务或新部署场景中无法适用。其解决方案的关键在于提出Agentic-Priors，即利用大语言模型（LLM）的隐含知识来生成可解释的用户偏好先验。具体而言，LLM能够以可理解的术语（如愿意支付的金额或时间价值）描述新用户的权衡取舍，并将这些语义信息映射为多项对数几率模型（multinomial logit）系数的先验分布。随后，该先验通过贝叶斯学习机制随着实际选择数据的积累不断优化。实验表明，在七个选择数据集上，Agentic-Priors相较于无信息先验可提升冷启动阶段的预测准确率5%至40%；在三个数据集上优于当前最先进的LLM先验生成方法AutoElicit，仅在一个数据集上略逊；且相比上下文学习（in-context learning），其性能最高可提升18个百分点，且始终不显著劣于后者。与基于逐步增加样本量的调查数据拟合的分层贝叶斯模型相比，该方法在对数损失（log-loss）上等价于获得了6至40名真实调查用户的效用，凸显其在部署初期前几轮用户交互中的核心价值。

Abstract:An agent that learns a user’s preferences from their choices faces a cold start problem: before any choices are observed, it must rely solely on a prior. Informative priors are usually fitted to historical choice data, which new tasks and deployments lack. To address this, we present Agentic-Priors, which lets agentic systems use the implicit knowledge of large language models (LLMs) instead. Specifically, an LLM states a new user’s trade-offs in interpretable terms, such as willingness to pay or value of time, which we map to a prior over multinomial logit coefficients. This prior is then refined by a Bayesian learner as choices are observed. Across seven choice datasets, Agentic-Priors improves cold start accuracy over an uninformed prior by 5-40 percentage points. It also outperforms AutoElicit, a state-of-the-art LLM prior-elicitation method, on three datasets and loses on one. It is up to 18 points more accurate than in-context learning, and never significantly worse. Against hierarchical Bayes models fitted to surveys of increasing size, our approach is worth roughly 6-40 surveyed users, in terms of log-loss, so its value is concentrated in a deployment’s first users.

[MA-8] Learning Rewards in Strategic Games

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在多智能体战略环境中，如何从智能体的观测行为中准确推断其潜在奖励函数（reward function）的问题。传统逆强化学习（Inverse Reinforcement Learning, IRL）在单智能体场景下表现良好，但在多智能体战略交互中面临根本性挑战：即使某个奖励函数能够解释观测到的行为，也不一定能在决策时诱导出最优策略，导致“战略可识别性”（strategic identifiability）不足。为此，本文提出一种针对双人重复斯塔克尔伯格博弈（Stackelberg game）的主动逆强化学习（active IRL）算法，其核心创新在于让领导者（leader）通过自适应选择策略来激发追随者（follower）的有信息量响应，从而高效获取关于追随者奖励函数的可辨识信息。该方法结合最大似然估计与实验设计，实现了对所学习奖励函数引起的斯塔克尔伯格次优性的有限样本保证，并达到了与新提出的最小最大学习率 $ K^{-1/2} $ 相近的性能，仅存在多对数因子差异。实验在真实的反盗猎场景中验证了主动探索在奖励恢复及下游战略性能上的显著优势。

Abstract:Understanding the objectives that drive agents’ behavior is crucial in strategic environments, where multiple agents interact and adapt to one another. This challenge arises in domains such as cybersecurity, autonomous driving, and online markets, where agents’ underlying incentives are typically unknown and must be inferred from their observed behavior. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a natural framework for this problem, but extending IRL to strategic multi-agent settings introduces a fundamental challenge: a reward that explains observed behavior does not necessarily induce optimal strategies when used for decision-making. In this work, we study this problem through the lens of \emphstrategic identifiability, and show that learning from a fixed policy pair can be insufficient to strategically identify rewards, independent of the number of expert samples K . Motivated by this, we introduce an active IRL algorithm for two-player repeated Stackelberg games, in which the leader adaptively selects policies to elicit informative responses about the follower’s reward. Combining maximum-likelihood estimation with experimental design, we derive finite-sample guarantees on the Stackelberg sub-optimality induced by the learned reward, matching up to polylogarithmic factors a new minimax learning rate of K^-1/2 . Finally, we evaluate our approach in a realistic anti-poaching setting, demonstrating the benefits of active exploration for reward recovery and downstream strategic performance.

[MA-9] MetaShare: Failure-Aware Collective Self-Improvement for Open-Ended Agents NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决开放式自进化智能体在迭代优化过程中因缺乏对失败经验的系统性记录与复用，导致搜索过程陷入冗余策略、进化效率低下的问题。现有方法如GEA（Generative Evolutionary Agents）虽能跨谱系共享经验，DGM-Hyperagents则可自我修改改进机制，但均未能有效保留和利用失败尝试中的知识，从而限制了探索多样性与收敛速度。其解决方案的关键在于提出MetaShare——一个具备失败感知能力的框架，通过记录成功与失败的智能体修改及其带符号的性能变化量（signed performance deltas），构建可追溯的跨分支知识库。在每一代进化前，MetaShare通过引入任务无关的审计机制注入缺失或代表性不足的机制类别，并结合基于嵌入的去重策略（de-ranking）降低检索冗余；同时，多个元智能体以异构温度并行生成修改建议，经由确定性选择器统一评估其适用性、作用范围、可编译性及规模等约束条件后进行筛选。实验表明，MetaShare在论文评审、代码生成、数学评分、机器人奖励设计及金融风险审计等多个任务中，中位性能达到或超越DGM-Hyperagents的最终水平，且实现最优代理性能所需演化迭代次数减少1.7至2.9倍，显著提升了进化效率与探索质量。

Abstract:Humans often learn fastest not by repeating success, but by remembering which failures not to repeat. Open-ended self-improving agents can share experience across lineages, as in GEA, or edit their own improvement mechanisms, as in DGM-Hyperagents, yet failed improvement attempts are rarely retained as reusable cross-branch knowledge, and search can collapse onto redundant strategies. We introduce MetaShare, a failure-aware framework that records successful and unsuccessful agent modifications together with signed performance deltas. Before each generation, MetaShare retrieves diverse high-performing strategies alongside high-confidence failures from other lineages, letting agents reuse effective mechanisms while avoiding known dead ends. A task-blind auditor periodically injects absent or underrepresented mechanism categories, while embedding-based de-ranking limits redundancy during retrieval. Multiple meta-agents propose modifications in parallel at heterogeneous temperatures behind a deterministic selector that gates applicability, scope, compilability, and size. Experiments across paper review, coding, math grading, robotics reward design, and financial audit-risk assessment show that MetaShare’s median matches or exceeds DGM-Hyperagents’ final performance and reaches its own best-performing agent in 1.7–2.9 \times fewer evolution iterations.

[MA-10] he Delegation Dilemma: Economies of Scale Accountability and Polycentric Governance

【速读】：该论文旨在解决集体行动系统中去中心化与中心化之间的张力问题，即在自愿组织形成制度、通过代表进行决策的治理模式下，如何平衡规模带来的成本分担收益与代表控制权滥用之间的矛盾。其核心问题是：当代表具有自利动机时，如何维持非剥削性的委托关系？解决方案的关键在于揭示“规模—问责”权衡机制（scale-accountability tradeoff）——群体规模越大，成员间成本分担越显著，但代表保留任一成员的边际价值随规模增长而下降，从而削弱其问责约束力。因此，个体退出的可能性仅能在内生决定的可问责群体规模上限内维持非剥削性委托。此外，研究发现，在某些参数条件下，可行的可问责治理必须采用多中心（polycentric）结构。通过大规模语言模型（LLM）代理的仿真验证表明，尽管多中心结构频繁出现且动态演化，呈现集中、剥削、退出与重组的周期性特征，但不同能力模型在领导意愿上相似，而在权力行使上存在显著差异：如Sol模型比Luna模型在相同决策状态下更频繁地发起剥削行为。

类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Many collective-action systems are neither fully decentralized nor fully centralized: agents voluntarily organize into institutions that share organizational costs and delegate decisions to representatives. Delegation can reduce individual costs, but it also transfers control to representatives whose private objectives need not align with those of their constituents. We study this tension in a repeated game with endogenous delegation to self-interested centers. A simple reduced-form model yields a scale–accountability tradeoff: larger constituencies offer greater cost-sharing benefits to members, yet the marginal value to a center of retaining any one constituent decreases as group size grows. Consequently, the prospect of individual exit can sustain non-exploitative delegation only up to an endogenous accountable constituency size. Additionally, we identify parameter regions in which fully delegated, accountable governance, when feasible, must be polycentric. We investigate these predictions through simulations with large language model (LLM) agents. Across five matched pairs of 30-agent simulations, polycentric structures repeatedly emerge but remain fluid, exhibiting cycles of concentration, exploitation, exit, and re-formation. We further find that models of different capacity exhibit similar willingness to assume leadership but differ substantially in their exercise of authority, with Sol initiating exploitation more frequently than Luna in matched decision states.

[MA-11] Agent Status Protocol (ASP): A Lightweight Specification for State Reporting in Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决异构人工智能（AI）代理在分布式系统中状态可见性与实时监控的难题，核心问题是：如何在不依赖代理自身可信报告的前提下，实现对代理运行状态（如存活、健康、任务进展、权限状态等）的准确、及时且多维度感知。传统方案依赖代理主动上报心跳或状态信息，但当代理崩溃、卡死或被攻陷时，其自报信息不可信，导致监控失效。为此，该论文提出轻量级代理状态协议（Agent Status Protocol, ASP），其关键解决方案在于构建一个基于多方观察与服务器推断相结合的去中心化状态聚合机制。具体而言，ASP通过服务器端对心跳缺失的检测来推断代理的非活跃状态，识别虽存活但停滞的代理，并支持来自监督者、护栏系统、操作员及同级代理的观测信息作为补充或优先级更高的状态依据；同时，协议采用多维状态建模（生命周期、健康度、任务状态、权限状态、治理状态），允许代理在不同维度上并行呈现复杂状态（如在线但降级、正在执行任务且等待调度权）。此外，ASP复用已有标准语义规范（如A2A协议的任务状态、OFP协议的权限状态、OpenTelemetry GenAI语义约定），提升互操作性。该论文发布ASP 0.1版本作为提案草案，旨在推动社区讨论与实践验证，尚未形成正式标准。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The Agent Status Protocol (ASP) defines a lightweight way for heterogeneous AI agents to report their operational state to a status server, and for observers such as dashboards to receive that state as soon as it changes. Agents push small JSON events over HTTP POST; the server exposes the aggregated state to observers over Server-Sent Events (SSE). Because an agent that has crashed, hung or been compromised cannot be trusted to report its own failure, ASP does not rely on self-reports alone: the server infers liveness from missed heartbeats, can detect agents that are alive but no longer making progress, and accepts observations from supervisors, guardrails, operators and peers, some of which take precedence over what the agent says about itself while others are shown alongside it. ASP models state along independent dimensions (lifecycle, health, task, floor, governance), so that an agent can be, for example, online, degraded, working on a task and waiting for the floor at the same time. It reuses existing vocabularies: task states from the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, floor states from the Open Floor Protocol (OFP), and attribute conventions from the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions. This paper presents version 0.1 of ASP as a proposal, not as an approved standard. It is a working draft intended to open a discussion, and the authors invite comments, alternative proposals and independent implementations from the community.

[MA-12] Bias Control and Injection for Multi-Agent Aggregation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体基于大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）进行集体决策时，当各智能体产生分歧时应信任哪个智能体决策的核心问题。其关键挑战在于，智能体的决策易受非语义性偏差（如多数压力、响应风格偏好）的影响，从而掩盖真实推理质量。解决方案的关键在于提出一种无需验证数据或先验模型强度知识的测试阶段聚合框架：通过“偏差控制”——对每个不同答案仅呈现风格归一化的推理路径，以减少响应风格带来的偏差；以及“偏差注入”——将每个聚合智能体最初选择的答案置于少数派位置，诱发决策不稳定性，进而作为可靠性信号。该方法在三个数学推理基准和四种异构LLM组合上均实现了更高的平均准确率与更优的词元效率，并可无缝应用于多智能体辩论与混合代理（Mixture-of-Agents）框架中，显著提升最终答案准确率，且无需修改原有交互或融合机制。

机构: POSTECH(浦项科技大学); Microsoft Research(微软研究院)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent reasoning with large language models (LLMs) raises a central question for collective decision-making: when agents disagree, whose decision should be trusted? Resolving such disagreements is difficult because agents’ decisions are susceptible to non-semantic biases such as majority pressure and response-style preferences, which can obscure the quality of the underlying reasoning. Our analysis shows how bias can be both mitigated and exploited: bias control improves initial answer selection, while bias injection elicits decision instability that serves as a reliability signal. Building on these findings, we introduce a test-time aggregation framework that requires neither validation data nor prior knowledge of relative model strength. The framework implements bias control by presenting one style-normalized reasoning trace per distinct answer, and bias injection by placing each aggregating agent’s initially selected answer in the minority. Overall, our framework achieves higher average accuracy and better token efficiency than competing non-oracle aggregation methods across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks and four heterogeneous LLM combinations. It also improves final-answer accuracy when applied to multi-agent debate and Mixture-of-Agents, without modifying their interaction or synthesis processes.

[MA-13] Diviner: Agent ic RCA with Human-Governed Adaptation for Large-Scale Infrastructure

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模分布式系统中根因分析（Root-Cause Analysis, RCA）的复杂性问题，其核心挑战在于单一故障症状可能跨越服务、数据、配置、计算及组织边界，导致响应者需在信息不完整的情况下整合多方专家知识并协调跨域因果路径。传统通用语言模型代理仅依赖工具调用无法有效应对此问题，常出现使用过时或误时机上下文、将查询失败误解为无症状、报告未支持的系统状态以及过度调用本为人类操作设计的可观测性服务等问题。为此，论文提出Diviner（Domain-Informed Verifiable Incident Navigation through Evidence and Review）——一个面向Meta生产环境的智能代理式RCA系统，围绕四阶段可靠性生命周期构建。其解决方案的关键在于：通过“编码”（Encode）阶段融合大量已审阅事件数据与服务负责人专业知识，生成可版本化、领域感知的技能、工作流、类型化工具与事件知识图谱；在“执行”（Execute）阶段采用自适应主控与上下文隔离的工作节点，基于时间点证据精准应用知识并维护可追溯的假设链；在“评估”（Evaluate）阶段通过对比历史调查轨迹与人工评审结果，量化根因识别准确性、方向有效性与证据依从性（Groundedness）；最后在“适应”（Adapt）阶段利用重复性漏洞与值班反馈，经回放验证、质量检查与所有者审批后，动态更新运营知识。整个系统通过结构化知识管理、证据驱动推理与闭环反馈机制，实现可信、可验证且可演进的自动化根因分析。

机构: Meta, Inc. (Meta)

Abstract:Root-cause analysis (RCA) in large-scale distributed systems is challenging because a single symptom can cross service, data, configuration, compute, and organizational boundaries. Responders must assemble incomplete evidence and coordinate experts who hold different parts of the causal path. Generic language-model agents do not solve this problem through tool access alone: they can use stale or mistimed context, interpret failed queries as absent symptoms, report unsupported system state, and overload observability services designed for human-paced use. We present Diviner (Domain-Informed Verifiable Incident Navigation through Evidence and Review), an agentic RCA system operating at Meta and organized around a four-stage reliability lifecycle. Encode combines a large corpus of reviewed incidents with service-owner expertise to produce scoped, versioned skills, workflows, typed tools, and an incident knowledge graph. Execute uses an adaptive Lead and context-isolated workers to apply relevant knowledge to point-in-time evidence and maintain evidence-linked hypotheses. Evaluate compares saved investigation trajectories with responder-reviewed outcomes to measure exact cause, useful direction, and Groundedness. Adapt uses recurring gaps and on-call feedback to derive focused operational- knowledge updates, admitting them only after replay, quality checks, and owner approval. [MA-14] A Responsibility-Centered Coordination Mechanism for Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决集中式协调（centralized orchestration）在多智能体系统中面临的可扩展性、适应性与集体性能瓶颈，以及去中心化方法在任务委派与故障恢复责任界定不清的问题。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种以责任为核心的协调机制（Responsibility-Centered Coordination, RCM），通过承诺（commitment）将任务委派与相关方的明确责任绑定，实现责任的显式传递与保留。RCM采用递归委派机制，使代理在向下委派任务的同时仍保有上游责任，并通过本地化的责任约束决策与面向责任的通信协议（Responsibility-Oriented Communication Protocol, RCP），支持代理自主建立、管理与终止承诺。由于代理并行执行，局部行为持续演化承诺图，从而无需中央控制即可涌现出全局协调与动态适应，最终在推理、编码及可执行代理环境中的实验表明，RCM在任务性能上优于强基准模型最高达18.7分，在责任度量上提升10.2分，且无需特定任务训练即可增强故障与危害检测能力。

作者: Thi-Nhung Nguyen,Viet-Thanh Pham,Linhao Luo,Thuy-Trang Vu,Dinh Phung
机构: Monash University (蒙纳士大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 14 pages, including appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Centralized orchestration provides comprehensive multi-agent coordination but creates bottlenecks in scalability, adaptability, and collective performance. Decentralized approaches alleviate these bottlenecks by distributing coordination across agents, yet often leave responsibility for delegated dependencies and failure recovery unclear. To address this gap, we propose RCM, a responsibility-centered coordination mechanism that leverages commitments to couple task delegation with explicit responsibilities of the involved parties. Through recursive delegation, agents retain their upstream responsibilities while locally orchestrating downstream commitments, thereby preserving accountability across delegation chains, creating a network of local orchestration. We operationalize this mechanism locally through responsibility-constrained decision-making and a responsibility-oriented communication protocol (RCP), enabling agents to autonomously establish, manage, and terminate commitments. As agents act in parallel, their local actions continuously evolve the commitment graph, allowing global coordination to emerge and adapt toward a shared mission without centralized control. Experiments across reasoning, coding, and executable agent environments demonstrate that RCM outperforms strong centralized and decentralized coordination baselines by up to 18.7 points in task performance and 10.2 points in Responsibility, while improving failure and harm detection without task-specific training.

[MA-15] SSR: Structural Signal Retriever for Scalable Agent Discovery in LLM -Orchestrated Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模多智能体生态系统中，大型语言模型（LLM）协调器在发现合适智能体时面临的候选上下文可扩展性问题。随着智能体注册表规模的扩大，直接将完整注册表暴露给LLM会导致提示词长度、推理成本、延迟显著增加，并可能超出模型上下文窗口限制。其核心挑战在于如何在不暴露全部注册信息的前提下，高效检索出相关智能体卡片（Agent Card），同时保持紧凑的候选上下文。解决方案的关键是提出一种确定性且无需训练的检索方法——结构信号检索器（Structural Signal Retriever, SSR）。SSR从承载能力的智能体卡片字段中提取结构化词汇信号，利用逆文档频率（IDF）对信号进行加权，并通过倒排信号索引（Inverted Signal Index, ISI）实现候选者的选择性评分。实验表明，在1,000个智能体场景下，SSR相较全目录调度可减少98.8%的LLM输入量并降低70.9%的调度延迟；在MS MARCO基准上，IDF提升了结构化表示下的检索效果，ISI在保持检索性能的同时将显式评分的段落数减少96.8%。端到端测试进一步验证了候选预筛选机制在注册表规模增长时仍能维持紧凑候选上下文，避免了全目录调度中的操作失败。因此，SSR作为一种原生面向智能体卡片、可追溯的检索机制，有效支撑了候选上下文的可扩展性。

作者: Giancarlo Maldonado Cárdenas,Carlos A. Astudillo,Nelson L. S. da Fonseca
机构: Institute of Computing – State University of Campinas (计算学院 – 坎皮纳斯州立大学), Brazil (巴西)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)

Abstract:Large-scale multi-agent ecosystems require mechanisms for discovering suitable agents without exposing entire registries to a large language model (LLM) orchestrator. The challenge is not only to retrieve relevant Agent Cards from a growing registry, but also to maintain a compact candidate context, since each additional candidate increases prompt size, inference cost, latency, and the risk of exceeding the model context window. We formulate this problem as candidate-context scalability and propose the Structural Signal Retriever (SSR), our deterministic and training-free retrieval method designed for Agent Card discovery. SSR derives structural lexical signals from capability-bearing Agent Card fields, weights them using inverse document frequency (IDF), and uses an Inverted Signal Index (ISI) for selective candidate scoring. We evaluate SSR using a synthetic agent benchmark, a public MS MARCO adaptation, and end-to-end LLM orchestration. At 1,000 agents, SSR reduces LLM input by 98.8% and orchestration latency by 70.9% relative to full-catalog orchestration. On MS MARCO, IDF improves retrieval effectiveness within the structural representation, while the ISI preserves retrieval effectiveness and reduces explicitly scored passages by 96.8%. End-to-end experiments show that candidate pre-selection maintains a compact candidate context as registry size grows and avoids the operational failures observed with full-catalog orchestration. These results support SSR as an Agent-Card-native, traceable retrieval mechanism for candidate-context scalability.

[MA-16] A Jury Not an Electorate: Label-Free Reliability Estimation for Ensembles of Language Models

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多模型集成（ensemble）中专家模型可信度评估的难题，即如何在缺乏标注数据的情况下，从多个语言模型的输出模式中自动推断各模型的可靠性。传统方法通常为每个专家分配固定的声誉权重，这些权重依赖于有标签数据进行学习，存在对监督信号的强依赖性。本文提出一种基于“陪审团”（jury）的建模框架，将每个专家视为对隐含真实答案作证的证人，其可靠性未知；通过期望最大化（Expectation Maximisation, EM）算法，仅依据未标注的模型输出配置中的共识与分歧模式，即可估计各专家的可靠性。关键创新在于：决策规则仍为对专家答案分布的加权线性组合，但权重由无监督的EM过程动态推断，而非依赖标签训练。在包含1560个问题的基准测试中，该方法使用九个参数量达30亿的专家模型，性能与使用标签训练的融合规则相当，且未表现出显著优势，但显著优于单一模型在自一致性匹配下的表现及现有最强的无标签替代方案，证明了无监督信誉推断的有效性。

作者: Alessandro Rozza,Davide Mambelli,Steven Motta,Juri Taresch

类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

Abstract:An ensemble of language models is a jury, not an electorate. The answers are testimony from witnesses of unknown reliability, and the question is not what the majority said but who is credible. Most ensemble methods assign each expert a fixed reputation, often learned from labels. We ask whether it can instead be inferred from the pattern of agreement and disagreement among the experts. We model the experts as a jury: each question has a latent true answer, each expert reports it with unknown reliability, and those reliabilities are estimated by Expectation Maximisation (EM) from unlabelled answer configurations alone. We show that its decision rule reduces to a log-odds weighted linear score over the experts’ answer distributions. What changes is not how the jury votes, but how it learns whom to trust. On a 1560-question benchmark, the jury, with nine experts of up to 3B parameters, performs comparably to the same fusion rule with label-fitted weights, showing no statistically significant advantage from supervision. Instead, it outperforms the best single model with matched self-consistency and the strongest label-free alternative on the full benchmark.

[MA-17] Athanor: An Agent -Native System for Autonomous Post-Training Research

【速读】：该论文旨在解决如何在无外部指导的情况下，使前沿人工智能（AI）代理自主完成对原始基础模型的后训练优化（post-training），从而实现跨领域通用能力的显著提升。其核心挑战在于验证当前大模型是否具备真正的研究自主性，即能否不依赖人类干预或教师模型，仅通过自身探索与迭代，持续改进模型性能。解决方案的关键在于构建一个名为Athanor的开放、原生支持自治后训练研究（AutoPostTrain）的系统框架：该系统为代理提供完全的研究自主权、低摩擦工程工具与高效启动代码，并在隔离沙盒环境中运行；代理可自主读取数据与评估结果、构建训练数据、编写和调整训练算法、调优超参数并基于分析决策下一步行动。实验中，四名Claude Opus 5.5代理在104小时内仅使用公开数据与自身协作，将Qwen3-4B-Base模型在六任务开发集上的表现从15.9提升至67.3，在保留测试集上从9.2提升至48.2，达到甚至超过官方Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507版本（66.5/47.9）。这一成果表明，当前先进代理已具备通过重组已有方法（如公共推理数据的监督微调、单个代理引入的强化学习策略、跨代理权重融合及多轮自蒸馏）实现自我增强的能力，证明了生成式AI（Generative AI）在无需外部干预下的工程与研究潜力。

作者: Yufa Zhou,Yichen Wang,Jiakun Fan,Ziqi Shu,Zhichao Liu,Anru R. Zhang,Neiwen Ling,Zijun Wei

类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

Abstract:Recursive self-improvement, in which AI systems build stronger AI systems, is one promising route to superintelligence. We study a weaker form that can be measured today: frontier agents post-training a small raw base model with public data, as a test of their research potential. We build Athanor, an open agent-native system for autonomous post-training research (AutoPostTrain) on real GPUs. We give the agents full research autonomy, low-friction engineering tools, and efficient starter code. The agents carry out the research themselves: they read datasets and evaluation results, build their training data, write and modify training algorithms, tune hyperparameters, and analyze the results to decide what to try next. They work in a sandbox and cannot use external teacher models. Athanor’s services supply frozen evaluation, managed jobs, decontaminated data, a persistent research record, and a held-out suite the agents are unaware of. In a 104-hour campaign, a team of four Claude Opus 5.5 agents, each on an eight-GPU node and given no research advice, improves Qwen3-4B-Base from 15.9 to 67.3 on a six-task development suite and from 9.2 to 48.2 on a held-out suite, against 66.5 and 47.9 for the official Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that a team of frontier agents can autonomously post-train a raw base model into a cross-domain generalist model that matches or surpasses the official instruct version on average. The campaign’s full record shows that the agents reach this level by recombining known methods and each other’s models: SFT on public reasoning data, RL with a rollout change one agent introduced, weight merges across agents, and rounds of self-distillation. With execution handled, today’s agents already have the engineering and research ability to conquer this task. We hope Athanor provides a foundation for scaling autonomous AI research.

[MA-18] Recursive Reward Improvement via Adversarial Meta-Prompt Evolution

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能在开放式专家任务（如临床报告生成）中因缺乏明确答案标准而导致的自洽性与质量下降问题。传统基于自我改进的递归框架在数学和编程等可自动验证的任务中表现良好，但在无固定答案键的开放任务中，模型生成的评分标准（rubric）易被解题模型钻空子——即仅表面提及预期内容而缺乏实质内涵，从而破坏学习过程。其解决方案的关键是提出一种名为递归奖励改进（Recursive Reward Improvement, RRI）的新机制：通过引入一个“奖励劫持对抗者”（reward hacking adversary），在解题模型训练前，先生成一个利用鲁棒性漏洞但内容无意义的“恶意答案”，同时生成一个不参考评分标准的诚实答案，并通过最多两步修复迭代优化原始评分标准，使诚实答案胜出。这一过程不仅提升了当前任务的可靠性，还通过反馈机制动态改善未来任务与评分标准的生成质量。实验表明，在HealthBench Professional基准上，RRI相较仅生成（Generation Only）基线分别在9B和27B参数规模下提升10.9和12.4分，且无需依赖外部模型即可实现10.3分增益；尤其在高难度与写作类任务中提升显著。此外，该方法在未见过的PRBench Hard和ProfBench测试集上仍分别获得6.6和8.0分的性能提升，验证了其泛化能力。研究进一步分析了模型生成的问题-评分对中的可被利用弱点，为后续开放域自洽学习提供了关键洞见。

作者: Wei Dai,Qianchu Liu,Guanghui Qin,Xing Han,Tristan Naumann,Paul Pu Liang,Sheng Zhang
机构: Massachusetts Institute of Technology(麻省理工学院); Microsoft Research(微软研究院); Johns Hopkins University(约翰霍普金斯大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

Abstract:Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) has gained wide attention for its ability to work with limited data. In a proposer-solver loop, a proposer model writes training tasks and a solver model learns to solve them through reinforcement learning. Such loops have succeeded in mathematics and coding, where every answer can be checked automatically. Open-ended expert tasks, like clinical report generations, have no answer key, which makes simple question-answer generation not viable. Here the proposer must also write a rubric that lists the content an answer should include and the errors it should avoid. However, the unique challenge behind model-written rubric is the comprehensiveness of it. For naively generated rubric, solvers tend to exploit it, naming the expected topics without the substance behind them, which corrupts the learning process. To solve this problem, we introduce RRI, Recursive Reward Improvement, which uses a reward hacking adversary to supervise the reward. Before the solver trains on a generated task, an adversary writes an answer that games its rubric while being as useless as possible, the same model writes an honest answer without seeing the rubric, and up to two repair steps revise the rubric to make the honest answer win. The exploits found also rewrite how future tasks and rubrics are generated. On HealthBench Professional, RRI improves the adjusted score over the Generation Only self-improvement baseline by 10.9 points at 9B and 12.4 at 27B, and by 10.3 points without any external model. In particular, the gains are largest on difficult and writing tasks. We show that the 27B model trained on the HealthBench Professional description improves by 6.6 points on PRBench Hard and 8.0 on ProfBench without seeing a task from either. We further analyze the exploitable points of model-generated question-rubric pairs to facilitate future research on open-ended self-play.

[MA-19] SCARCE: Emergent Institutions in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Coding Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统在长期、高复杂度任务中因共享计算资源竞争而产生的协调与安全问题。随着自主智能体在现实场景中的广泛应用，其在无预设规则下自发形成的交互行为可能引发不可控的协同或冲突，但现有研究多依赖简化博弈模型，难以揭示真实环境中智能体协商行为的演化机制。为此，本文提出SCARCE（Shared Compute ARena for Coding agEnts）框架，使智能体在具有个体截止时间约束的连续编码任务中，通过协商获取共享执行资源（如代码编译与测试权限），从而模拟真实场景下的资源竞争。研究发现，智能体自发形成了以声誉、互惠和先例为基础的非正式制度性行为，即“制度化行为”——这些行为表现为跨任务持续存在的规则与承诺，甚至导致智能体主动放弃即时利益以遵守过往约定。作者构建了包含21类策略与涌现规范的分类体系，对8种模型在超过1500条轨迹中的表现进行系统分析，结果表明前沿大模型较旧版或轻量模型表现出更强的制度化倾向。此外，除合作外，还观察到排他性联盟及罕见的分化瓦解策略。SCARCE为多智能体系统中协作关系的形成、资源分配模式及其对安全性与协调性的影响提供了可控制、可审计的实验环境，推动了对智能体间复杂社会性行为的深入理解。

作者: Abhinav Kumar,Rediet Abebe,Eugene Bagdasarian,Sahar Abdelnabi
机构: University of Massachusetts Amherst; ELLIS Institute Tübingen; MPI for Intelligent Systems; Tübingen AI Center
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As autonomous agents become widely deployed, coordinating access to shared computing resources and services will become increasingly important. Recent incidents have already revealed unplanned coordination between agents, highlighting the safety implications of these interactions. Yet prior studies of agent negotiation often use stylized games and simulated bargaining, leaving open how these behaviors develop during sustained, long-horizon tasks. We propose SCARCE (Shared Compute ARena for Coding agEnts), a framework in which agents solve sequences of coding tasks under individual deadlines while negotiating access to a shared execution resource. This negotiation determines when and for how long they can inspect programs, compile code, and run tests. We find that agents spontaneously develop informal institutions: persistent rules and commitments grounded in reputation, reciprocity, and precedent. These arrangements, which we call institutional behaviors, carry across tasks and influence resource allocation, with agents sometimes foregoing immediate advantages to honor earlier agreements. We develop a 21-category taxonomy of negotiation strategies and emergent norms and use it to analyze eight models and audit more than 1,500 trajectories across different environmental settings. Among the models tested, newer frontier models exhibit more institutional behaviors than older or lightweight models. Alongside cooperation, we observe exclusionary coalitions and rare divide-and-conquer strategies. SCARCE provides a controlled setting for proactively and systematically auditing how these relationships emerge, shape access to resources, and affect the safety and coordination of multi-agent systems.

[MA-20] A Multi-Tiered AI Accessibility Model (MAIAM): Proportionate Access and Capability Limits for Comprehensive Frontier AI Safety

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前关于释放高能力人工智能系统时存在的二元化决策框架问题，即仅在“通过API封闭”与“公开模型权重”之间做选择，这种框架混淆了两个独立的决策维度：系统的潜在能力水平，以及谁能在何种条件下获得该能力。论文聚焦于后者——即能力获取的准入机制。其核心解决方案是提出一种多层级人工智能可访问性模型（Multi-Tiered AI Accessibility Model, MAIAM），该模型不再依据发布形式（如权重文件或API）划分访问权限，而是基于目的、安全性和能力三个维度进行分层管理。具体而言，MAIAM划分为三级：Tier 1（AI for Learning）面向教育用途，广泛开放但能力受限；Tier 2（AI for Exploration）用于研究开发，需注册、身份验证及使用控制，且随着能力提升而收紧；Tier 3（Full-Scale Frontier AI）仅限于经过结构化、可追溯和可问责的渠道获取。其核心原则是可访问性应与能力、安全性及风险相匹配。论文进一步论证，公开前沿级模型权重将导致开发者在发布后丧失所有安全控制手段，并指出仅以数百美元即可剥离安全微调，因此基线模型评估难以反映衍生系统的实际安全性。为此，作者提出结合“SAFE AI Operating Point”构建双边界框架：能力边界（Capability Boundary）设定不可逾越的安全阈值，而可访问性边界（Accessibility Boundary）则界定低于该阈值能力的获取资格。研究表明，仅设定能力上限不足以确保安全，必须辅以由监管机构管理的分层访问制度。

作者: Chai K. Toh,Vasu Raj Jain
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Most debate about releasing capable AI systems treats the choice as binary: keep the model behind an API, or publish the weights. That framing runs together two separate decisions. One is how capable a system may become. The other is who may obtain a given capability, and on what terms. This paper is about the second decision. We propose a Multi-Tiered AI Accessibility Model (MAIAM) that sorts access by purpose, safety, and capability instead of by release artifact. Tier 1, AI for Learning, is broadly accessible and deliberately capability-bounded. Tier 2, AI for Exploration, serves research and development under registration, identity, and usage controls that tighten as capability rises. Tier 3, Full-Scale Frontier AI, is available only through structured, recorded, and accountable access. The principle behind the tiers is that accessibility should be proportional to capability, safety, and risk. We show why publishing frontier-class weights forfeits every safety lever a developer has after release, and, using evidence that safety fine-tuning can be stripped from open weights for a few hundred dollars, why an evaluation of the base model says little about its derivatives. We give criteria for assigning a system to a tier along capability, autonomy, domain-consequence, and usage/safety axes, and combine MAIAM with the SAFE AI Operating Point into a two-part framework: a Capability Boundary that fixes the safety limits not to be crossed, and an Accessibility Boundary that fixes who may obtain a capability below that limit. Capability limits alone do not make AI safe; a tiered access regime administered by regulating bodies is also needed.

[MA-21] Feasibility Ceilings Before Learning: Sizing and Timing Bounds for Drone-Mesh Interception

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统中，多个拦截器（interceptors）如何在预测目标到达点时实现最优分布以最大化覆盖概率的问题。核心挑战在于：在给定的探测不确定性与空间约束下，如何通过理论分析确定性能上限，并为后续策略优化提供基准。其解决方案的关键在于提出一系列闭式表达式（closed-form expressions），用于精确量化未选择具体策略前的理论性能边界，包括基于最小二乘法方差传播与Delta方法修正的预测点不确定性模型、密集网格覆盖概率的精确解析解及其体积类比形式。研究发现，由于智能体间至少保持2r距离的分离约束，平面与三维空间中的最大覆盖率分别被限制在90.69%和74.05%，这一上限由几何约束决定而非问题本质；允许重叠可突破此限，引入Kershner最稀疏覆盖密度并显著提升性能，尤其在覆盖率阈值p > 0.80时进入更优区域。此外，六边形排列优于其他五种布局，而重心-维诺（centroidal-Voronoi）配置在资源有限时仅能达到最优覆盖的一半。研究还揭示了高斯假设在存在重尾或各向异性时具有保守性，但在存在偏差（如一倍标准差的目标偏移）时极为脆弱，导致覆盖损失高达14个百分点。最后，通过对比分析表明，尽管集中式PPO算法在不同训练种子下平均优于基线策略约15%，但其仍远未达到理论上限，而解析式部署方案可达到理论容量的85%。因此，论文主张在任何学习实验之前应先计算并报告此类理论天花板，以确保结果评估的科学性与可比性。

Abstract:A mesh of interceptors defending a fixed site must spread over the predicted arrival point of an approaching object. This is a recurring task in multi-agent robotics: N agents, each covering a disc of radius r, spread over a probability density so that a point drawn from it falls within some agent’s disc. We give closed forms for the quantities that bound performance before any policy is chosen, and validate each by Monte Carlo. The uncertainty of a point predicted by extrapolating a noisy linear track follows from least-squares variance propagation plus a delta-method term for the uncertain arrival time, agreeing with simulation to within 1.8%. The coverage probability of a packed mesh admits a closed form accurate to 0.007 absolute, with a volumetric analogue. A naive area ratio misses a ceiling: while agents stay at least 2r apart, no mesh exceeds 90.69% coverage in the plane or 74.05% in a volume. This ceiling belongs to the separation constraint, not to the problem - permitting overlap substitutes Kershner’s thinnest-covering density and removes it, the better regime above a crossover at p=0.80. Hexagonal packing is optimal among five arrangements; the centroidal-Voronoi configuration coverage control supplies reaches only half its coverage at small budgets. The Gaussian assumption is conservative under heavy tails and anisotropy but fragile under bias: a one-sigma aim-point offset costs 14 points of coverage. A repositioning team must also choose a commit time, and the admissible window can be empty. Against the applicable ceiling, analytic placement attains 85% of what the configuration permits while centralised PPO averages 15% over three trainer seeds, with a paired bootstrap against a null policy containing zero at every seed. We argue such ceilings should be computed before any learning experiment and quoted alongside every result.

[NLP-0] OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决复杂多模态场景下视觉验证器（visual verifier）在处理组合性要求时的鲁棒性不足问题，尤其是传统二值化验证器（binary verifier）仅输出“真/假”离散判断，难以提供细粒度、可解释的评估信号。其核心解决方案是提出一种点级评分式生成式视觉验证器（pointwise graded verifier），能够自动将复杂提示或环境规则分解为细粒度组件，并对每个组件赋予连续得分，从而生成结构化且可解释的批判性反馈信号。该方法的关键在于引入一种解耦强化学习训练策略（Decoupled RL training strategy），通过联合优化子问题层面的二值判断与全局一致性评分，利用精确的局部反馈来构建细粒度验证能力，进而支撑全局连续评分的可靠性。实验表明，该框架在文本到图像生成及基于规则的生成式世界建模（rule-governed generative world modeling）任务中均显著优于传统二值验证器；此外，理论分析与实证结果进一步验证了在有真实图像作为参考时，成对比较式验证范式（pairwise verification paradigm）能提供更准确的批判信号。整体研究揭示了一个关键洞见：从生成模型向结构化世界建模智能体演进，其核心依赖于高精度的成对评分式视觉验证器的可用性。

作者: Bowei Liu,Xinchen Zhang,Xuhuan Li,Tianlin Zhang,Kaian Jiang,Jingwei Liu,Congyang Zhao,Yifei Qian,Junhong Liu,Zhiheng Li,Yujiu Yang,Yang Cai,Ling Yang

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique signal. Our experiments further demonstrate that these structured and interpretable outputs improve the verifier’s generalization to out-of-domain multimodal critic tasks. To train this verifier, we introduce a Decoupled RL training strategy that jointly optimizes sub-question-level binary judgment and global alignment scoring, using precise local feedback to develop fine-grained verification capabilities that provide a foundation for reliable continuous scoring at the global level. Under a general reinforcement learning framework, we first empirically demonstrate that the proposed pointwise graded verifier significantly outperforms binary verifiers in traditional text-to-image scenarios. We then extend our investigation to rule-governed generative world modeling where generative models are leveraged for world simulation and world reasoning under explicit rules. From a theoretical standpoint, we further show that a pairwise verification paradigm yields more accurate critiques than the pointwise formulation when ground-truth images are available, with empirical results on diverse structured world-modeling tasks such as Maze and Sudoku further validating the effectiveness of our approach. Overall, our findings suggest a key insight: the transition from generative models to structured world-modeling agents critically hinges on the availability of accurate pairwise graded visual verifiers.

[NLP-1] FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有智能体评估基准在真实客户交付场景中适用性不足的问题。传统基准多基于明确界定的任务（如工单、需求文档），而现实中的客户交付任务具有高度不确定性：前线部署工程师（FDEs）需在未明确定义的需求下开展工作，于生产环境中操作并识别隐含约束。为填补这一差距，研究提出FDE-Gym，一个包含95个端到端交付任务的基准，源自18个行业共20个真实客户场景，由领域专家从实际项目中提炼改编。该基准通过模拟客户环境，引入脚本化利益相关者与可配置的客户系统，使智能体在与利益相关者交互及操作类生产系统的过程中完成交付。其评分机制以客户自身成功指标的改进程度为核心，归一化至0（无变化）至1（参考解决方案），并施加对沟通次数、试运行和等待时间的惩罚。评估结果显示，在需主动发现隐含约束的真实情境下，表现最优的模型平均得分仅为0.56，仅能成功解决14项任务（得分≥0.8且无事故）。关键瓶颈在于隐含约束的发现能力——当缺乏显式提示时，性能显著下降；但即使在已获取所有关键信息的任务中（共23项），该模型也仅在其中10项达到0.8以上的业务提升，表明单纯的信息获取不足以实现有效交付。因此，该研究揭示了当前模型在处理真实世界复杂性方面存在显著能力鸿沟，核心挑战在于如何在不确定环境中进行有效的认知推理与动态决策，而非仅依赖任务求解能力。

Abstract:Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer’s own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.

[NLP-2] MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agent ic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在长期自主机器学习工程（Machine Learning Engineering, MLE）任务中因实验周期长、反馈延迟且决策依赖历史轨迹而导致的优化效率低下问题。其核心挑战在于如何从复杂的多轮交互轨迹中提取有效的监督信号，并在不等待完整执行流程结束的情况下实现策略的渐进式修正。解决方案的关键在于提出一种后训练（post-training）方法，结合层级化代理监督微调（Hierarchical agentic SFT）与基于窗口的强化学习（Windowed Interaction RL, WIRL），通过将连续实验结果间的一系列决策视为“执行窗口”，并赋予统一的结果导向奖励，从而实现对中间结果的有效利用。同时，采用异步数据收集与策略校正机制，在轨迹未完成时即进行策略更新，显著提升了长期优化过程中的学习效率。该方法被应用于训练名为MLExpert的350亿参数混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）代理模型，在MLE-Bench Lite上将基础模型的平均奖牌率从37.9%提升至72.7%，性能接近更大型前沿模型，且在NatureBench Lite、代理骨架优化和算法优化等任务上均展现出良好的泛化能力，验证了其在复杂自优化任务中的有效性。

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies based on execution feedback. However, feedback from each experiment reflects several preceding decisions, and a long MLE run contains many such costly experiments. Training must therefore select useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learn from intermediate outcomes. We propose a post-training method for autonomous long-horizon MLE optimization and apply it to train MLExpert, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model. We design the Kaggle-MLE Factory to construct executable tasks and an interaction harness for model-directed experimentation. Hierarchical agentic SFT transfers general tool-use and coding capabilities to MLE through outcome-guided supervision. Windowed Interaction RL (WIRL) treats the multi-turn decisions between successive experiment results as an execution window and assigns it a shared outcome-based reward. Asynchronous collection and policy correction support policy updates before the trajectory ends. On MLE-Bench Lite, MLExpert improves the average medal rate of the base model from 37.9% to 72.7%, achieving performance comparable to larger frontier models such as Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3. Further experiments show that MLExpert improves performance on NatureBench Lite, agent scaffold optimization, and algorithm optimization, suggesting that the learned optimization capability generalizes to other tasks.

[NLP-3] Evaluation Awareness Beyond English: Do LLM s Act Differently When Tested in Indic Languages?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言环境下大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在安全评估中表现出的“评估意识”（evaluation awareness）问题，尤其关注在印地语等印地语系（Indic）语言中的表现。现有研究几乎仅聚焦于英语场景，而印地语系语言服务于超过十亿用户，其安全评估的可靠性存在显著盲区。研究通过在五种印地语系语言及英语中测试四个指令微调模型，发现当模型被告知处于监控或安全测试状态时，其拒绝有害请求的频率显著上升——在印地语系语言中平均提升14.4个百分点，且拒绝率已接近英语水平；然而，这一机制也导致对无害请求的误拒率从6.9%升至11.3%，表明评估环境可能扭曲模型在真实使用中的行为表现。解决方案的关键在于揭示并量化评估意识在非英语语境下的普遍性与影响，强调当前基于英语的安全评估框架在多语言场景下可能无法准确反映模型的真实行为，从而呼吁建立更具语言包容性的安全评估方法。研究还公开了全部47,880条标注响应数据，以支持后续跨语言安全性研究。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) can often tell when they are being tested. This ability, known as evaluation awareness, can lead models to act more cautiously during safety evaluations than in real use. Existing work has studied evaluation awareness almost entirely in English, although models serve users in many languages. Indic languages are spoken by over a billion people, yet evaluation awareness remains almost entirely unstudied in them. We test four instruction-tuned models from three families in five Indic languages alongside English. A set of cues varies whether the model is told that it is monitored and whether the monitoring is a safety test. Models refuse harmful requests more often when they are told that they are being tested. This increase appears in all four models and all six languages. In Indic languages, refusal of harmful requests rises by 14.4 percentage points on average. The test cue also brings Indic refusal of harmful requests level with English, but raises refusal of benign Indic requests from 6.9% to 11.3%. We release all 47,880 judged responses to support further work. These results suggest that safety evaluations in Indic languages may not reflect how models treat their everyday users.

[NLP-4] wice Upon a Time: Complementary Representations for Time-Series Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决时间序列语言模型（Time Series Language Models, TSLMs）在表示学习中如何平衡信息保留与变异因素剔除的核心问题，即：时间序列表征应保留哪些关键信息，又应剥离哪些无关变化。现有TSLMs通常仅使用单一表征形式，导致其在下游任务中具有固定的归纳偏置，限制了模型对复杂时序结构的理解能力。为此，本文提出以互补表征（complementary representations）为设计原则，构建双视图架构：一是折线图表征，保留绝对测量值和原始坐标系信息；二是归一化延迟嵌入（normalized delay embeddings），通过消除正幅值缩放与偏移量的影响，同时凸显时间结构。两种视图分别由专用视觉编码器处理，并通过视觉标记（visual tokens）和多层次特征融合整合至共享语言模型中。评估阶段的干预实验验证了两种视图具备不同的不变性特性，且单视图消融实验表明二者结合在预测与推理任务中显著优于基础感知能力。基于Qwen3-VL-8B构建的双视图模型将TSRBench准确率从仅使用折线图的44.5%提升至53.2%，远超当前最强专用TSLM基线（36.7%），并在TSExam上达到89.9%、多变量ChatTS对齐任务中实现86.8%的数值准确率。结果表明，互补表征能够有效支持通用型TSLM的设计，使模型既能利用时间结构，又不丢失原始测量框架的语义信息。

Abstract:Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) enable language-based understanding and reasoning over temporal data, yet a fundamental question remains: what information should their time-series representations preserve, and what variation should they factor out? Existing TSLMs typically expose the language model to a single representation, imposing a fixed inductive bias across downstream tasks. We instead introduce complementary representations as a design principle for time-series reasoning. Our model combines two visual views: line plots preserve absolute measurements and the observed coordinate frame, while normalized delay embeddings factor out positive amplitude rescaling and offsets while exposing temporal structure. Dedicated visual encoders integrate both views into a shared language model through visual tokens and multi-level feature fusion. Evaluation-time interventions verify that the two views exhibit distinct invariance profiles, while single-view ablations show that their combination is particularly beneficial beyond basic perception, with the large gains in prediction and reasoning. Built on Qwen3-VL-8B, our dual-view model improves overall TSRBench accuracy from 44.5% with line plots alone to 53.2%, substantially exceeding the strongest evaluated dedicated TSLM baseline at 36.7%. It further achieves 89.9% accuracy on TSExam and 86.8% numerical accuracy on multivariate ChatTS alignment. Together, these results demonstrate that complementary representations provide an effective design principle for general-purpose TSLMs, enabling models to exploit temporal structure without sacrificing access to the original measurement frame.

[NLP-5] raining Reasoning Models to Generate Diverse Scientific Ideas

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能在科研创意生成过程中存在的创意多样性不足问题。尽管现有研究多聚焦于提升单个创意的质量，却忽视了创意集合的整体多样性，而多样性的缺失可能导致创新潜力受限。为此，本文提出一种基于集合层级强化学习（set-level reinforcement learning）的解决方案，其核心在于通过联合评分机制优化一组创意的整体表现：在单次生成中，模型输出K个结构化的创意卡片，每个创意的质量得分会根据其与先前生成创意之间的语义距离进行加权调整，从而激励模型主动生成与已有创意差异显著的新想法。这一机制有效引导模型在保持高质量的同时增强创意间的区分度。实验结果表明，所训练的8B规模模型在无污染基准测试中，其综合衡量质量与多样性的“创造性效用”优于Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-6 Astra；初步的人工评估显示，专家认为其创意集与Claude Opus 4.8相当，且略具更多独特性；此外，在代码代理执行概念验证实验时，该模型的成功率@k与Claude Opus 4.8相当，证明增加多样性并未牺牲可执行性。

Abstract:One of the first steps of a research pipeline is generating ideas. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate this step, but most of this work optimizes the quality of individual ideas, while overlooking diversity. In our work, we study document-grounded ideation, focusing on increasing the diversity of LLM generated ideas and ensuring they are high quality. Given prior papers, a model must propose a set of ideas that are each high-quality and clearly distinct from one another, while also being grounded in the input documents. To optimize for this, we propose training with a set-level reinforcement learning objective. In our setup, in a single generation, the model writes K structured idea cards grounded in the source papers, and the set is scored jointly, where each idea’s quality is weighted by its distance from the ideas written before it. This teaches the model to steer each new idea away from its predecessors. We show that our trained 8B model achieves higher creative utility (a measure combining quality and diversity) than Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-6 Astra on our contamination-free benchmark. In a pilot human study with four experts, our sets are judged as promising as Claude Opus 4.8’s and contain marginally more unique ideas. When a coding agent runs proof-of-concept experiments on the ideas, our model’s success@k is comparable to Claude Opus 4.8’s, so we see that the added diversity does not cost any executability.

[NLP-6] MindEval2: Clinically Grounded Patients and Rubrics for Evaluating Language Models in Mental Health Support ALT

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前用于评估心理健康支持类AI聊天机器人的评测方法中存在的关键问题：现有基准测试在模拟多轮交互时依赖过于理想化且自我反思过度的合成患者，且评价体系多采用难以解释的李克特量表（Likert scale），缺乏实际临床指导意义。为此，论文提出MindEval2评估框架，其核心在于双组件设计——一是由博士级心理学家共同开发的“心理健康质量评分标准（Mental Health Quality Rubrics, MHQR）”，将响应质量分解为可操作、可解释的明确指标，显著提升评价结果的透明性与实用性；二是“MindSim”患者模拟系统，通过精心设计的患者档案与工具集成，实现更具多样性、挑战性与真实性的交互，并引入记忆更新机制以建模心理健康支持的纵向动态过程。在对18个专有及开源模型的评估中发现，尽管前沿模型在表面质量与边界处理上已有显著改进，但“引导校准”（guidance calibration）仍是普遍存在的主要缺陷，构成了当前性能差距的核心原因。

Abstract:With people increasingly turning to AI chatbots for mental health support, the need to evaluate these tools is becoming more pressing. Recent benchmarks attempt to mimic a realistic setting by simulating multi-turn interactions with synthetic patients and evaluating them with an LLM-as-a-judge. However, the usefulness of these methods is limited because simulated patients can be overly forthcoming and self-reflective, and judgments typically involve opaque Likert scales with unclear practical utility. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MindEval2, an evaluation framework that consists of two components: Mental Health Quality Rubrics (MHQR), for evaluation, and MindSim, for patient simulation. For MHQR, we collaborate with PhD-level psychologists to develop a set of rubrics that break down response quality into explicit operational criteria that are more interpretable and actionable than existing evaluation taxonomies. MindSim, in turn, is an LLM harness that combines carefully-designed patient profiles with tools, enabling more varied, challenging, and realistic interactions than existing baselines. The harness also contains a memory component that is updated between each interaction, enabling MindEval2 to model the longitudinal aspect of mental health. We evaluate 18 proprietary and open-weight models on MindEval2, finding that while frontier models have largely improved on issues related to surface level quality and boundaries, guidance calibration remains the dominant failure mode across all models, accounting for most of the quality gap.

[NLP-7] Grid-Bench: Can LLM s Predict How Discrete Worlds Change?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在处理复杂、多步空间操作序列时，对最终空间状态预测的准确性问题。具体而言，研究关注的是当多个空间操作按顺序作用于一个由离散网格表示的环境时，模型能否准确推断出经过一系列变换后的完整空间状态。其解决方案的关键在于提出Grid-Bench——一个可执行的基准测试框架，通过八类不同的空间操作，在二维、三维及四维离散网格上模拟动态变化过程。该框架以文本形式提供初始状态、明确规则和事件历史，要求模型预测完整的最终网格状态，并支持基于参考执行的逐元素验证，从而实现对不同空间操作类型、历史长度和任务负载下模型表现的精确量化比较。实验表明，尽管部分模型在单个事件上的精确匹配率相近，但在长历史序列中，其整体状态预测的准确率显著下降，且在相同实例中错误单元的数量存在显著差异，揭示了模型在状态演化推理中的细微差别。Grid-Bench使得完整状态恢复能力以及模型间差异在多种空间条件下均可直接测量，为评估和理解LLMs在空间推理任务中的行为提供了新工具。

作者: Zixiang Xu,Zirui Song,Wanrong Zheng,Chiyu Zhang,Yue Huang,Yuyang Peng,Kexin Zhang,Jinkun Chen,Xiuying Chen,Xiangliang Zhang,Yan Liu,Laurent Itti,Frank Shyu,Xiaoqiang Luo,Sandeep Pandey,Xi Liu,Luke Simon,Xiyang Hu,Yue Zhao
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 39 pages, 15 figures, 15 tables, including appendices. Project website: this https URL ; Code: this https URL ; Data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Spatial instructions describe how to move objects, transform regions, or modify their surroundings. When several operations are applied in sequence, each acts on a configuration shaped by earlier changes. How accurately can large language models (LLMs) predict the resulting spatial state? We introduce Grid-Bench, an executable benchmark in which eight families of operations transform discrete worlds represented as two-, three-, and four-dimensional grids. Given an initial grid, explicit rules, and an event history expressed as text, a model predicts the complete final grid. Reference execution makes every predicted value checkable, supporting comparisons across spatial operations, history lengths, and workloads. Evaluating six LLMs shows that complete-state accuracy falls sharply as histories grow, with substantial divergence among models that perform similarly on single events. Models with similar exact-match accuracy can nevertheless differ substantially in the number of incorrect cells on shared instances. Even over long histories, some models recover many correct changes beyond what copying the initial state would yield. Grid-Bench makes both complete recovery and these differences in returned states directly measurable across a range of spatial conditions.

[NLP-8] Knowledge That Is Linear Before Fine-Tuning Generalizes After It

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型在知识记忆与泛化能力之间的不对称性问题，即并非所有可召回的事实都能同等支持模型在新任务中的泛化。其核心问题是：哪些事实能够促进模型从训练数据中提取出可迁移的结构化知识，从而实现跨样本的推理？ 解决方案的关键在于区分“活跃事实”（active facts）与“惰性事实”（inert facts）——前者所蕴含的语义结构在预训练表征中具有高度线性可读性（linearly readable），能支持模型在未见样本上进行有效泛化；后者虽可被准确回忆，但其结构无法被有效读出，因而不支持泛化。研究通过重构关系并施加随机标签扰动，发现模型能否将已学习的新关系推广至共享原答案的未见样本（如从“巴黎-螃蟹”推断“慕尼黑-螃蟹”），主要取决于原关系在预训练表示中的线性可读程度，而非单纯的记忆能力或训练样本数量。这一现象在11个语言模型和70个关系上均表现出强一致性（皮尔逊相关系数r = 0.87–0.92），且在控制多种变量后依然稳健，表明泛化能力的关键在于预训练表征中潜在结构的线性可解码性，而非事实本身的可回忆性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22300
作者: Faridoun Mehri,Hinrich Schütze
机构: Center for Information and Language Processing, LMU Munich(慕尼黑大学信息与语言处理中心); Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML)(慕尼黑机器学习中心)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 25 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Not all facts a language model can recall support further learning equally well. We distinguish active facts, which support generalization beyond their own recall, from inert facts, which can be recalled but do not support such generalization in a given task. We study this distinction by constructing new relations from existing ones. Take the relation that maps a place to its continent (Paris - Europe) and assign each of its answers an arbitrary new label (Europe - crab, Asia - zebra). The new relation then maps Paris - crab. We fine-tune the model on the new relation for a subset of subjects, without telling it the original relation or the relabeling rule, and test whether it assigns the corresponding labels to held-out subjects that share an answer in the original relation. Having learned Paris - crab, does it answer Munich - crab? Across eleven language models and 70 relations, how linearly readable the original relation is in pretrained representations strongly predicts this generalization. Within each model, the two correlate across relations at Pearson r = 0.87 to 0.92. This association persists when controlling, separately and jointly, for the number of fine-tuning subjects and answers, the model’s accuracy on the original relation, and how often the subjects occur in pretraining text. It is also robust to re-randomizing the label assignment and fine-tuning seed, and to replacing the animal labels with labels from thirteen other semantic categories. When we map a fine-tuned model’s wrong label back to the original answer it was assigned to, Munich - zebra becomes Munich - Asia. Answers recovered this way are more often among the linear probe’s top answers for the subject than among the pretrained model’s own. Whether a new relation generalizes depends less on whether its facts can be recalled than on how readily their shared structure can be read out linearly.

[NLP-9] AI Consilium: a Benchmark of LLM Clinical Multidisciplinary Second Opinions

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在生成复杂临床病例的鉴别诊断时，如何确保其提供的第二意见具备事实依据、临床一致性、可操作性及安全性的问题。核心挑战在于，尽管LLMs能够生成诊断假设，但其输出往往缺乏严谨的临床推理链条与多角色协同整合能力，难以满足真实医疗决策场景的需求。为此，研究提出了一种多维度评估基准，基于300例已确诊的《新英格兰医学杂志》-医考题库（NEJM-MedQA）案例，构建了包含110例用于医生评分校准与裁判模型训练、190例用于独立评估的测试集。通过八种单模型流水线，在自由文本与结构化临床推理两种条件下生成独立角色意见及交互式会诊报告，并由经过医生校准的LLM裁判对3,040份最终报告及其原始角色输出进行评估。研究发现，模型身份对报告质量的影响显著高于响应格式；在七种模型流水线中，结构化最终报告整体得分更高，尤其在管理建议方面优势明显（2.740 vs. 2.436）。相较于结构化预会诊角色意见，完整的结构化综合报告在五项共享标准上均表现更优，尤其在问题优先级排序、事实依据和推理连贯性方面提升显著。GPT-5.6-Sol在所有评估维度中领先，并以最少的评审轮次达成共识。研究表明，该基准能有效区分模型能力差异、多学科协作的价值、响应结构对特定评价维度的影响、协商过程动态以及不同推理需求在统一病例评估中的作用。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22298
作者: Alexey A. Bokov,Ivan I. Panin,Nikolay B. Nechaev,Mikhail Yu. Valkov,Valeria Yu. Chernina,Natalia Gombolevskaya,Ayyaz Hussain,Vladimir M. Agafonov,Victor A. Gombolevskiy,Aleksandr V. Nesterov,Iaroslav R. Bespalov,Ivan V. Oseledets,Dmitry V. Dylov
机构: AIRI(人工智能研究院); Northern State Medical University (北方国家医科大学); Arkhangelsk Clinical Oncological Dispensary (阿尔汉格尔斯克临床肿瘤学诊所); Intelligent Radiology Assistance Laboratories LLC (IRA LABS) (智能放射学辅助实验室有限责任公司); “Professor Gorbakov Clinic” LLC (戈尔巴科夫教授诊所有限责任公司); Department of Anesthesiology and Intensive Care Medicine, First City Hospital named after E. E. Volosevich (埃·埃·沃洛谢维奇市立第一医院麻醉与重症监护医学部); Sechenov University (谢切诺夫大学); Skoltech (斯科尔科技研究所)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
