点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent literature shows that unsafe tool calls can often accompany textual refusals in language models. To investigate this hidden vulnerability, we introduce PRISM, a framework for evaluating the transfer of activation interventions across precision, languages, and scales. Our findings demonstrate that leveraging lower-resource settings (specifically quantized NF4 labels and cross-lingual transfer) offers a robust pathway to expose and improve model alignment. Notably, using behavioral labels from an NF4 copy enables stable intervention estimation even with very few scenarios. Furthermore, these alignment improvements transfer effectively across languages: five-language NF4-supervised directions successfully transfer to held-out Arabic, reducing unsafe violations in Llama-3.1-8B by 21.95 percentage points without target-language tuning. By mapping paired benign activations, we also successfully transfer these safety interventions to much larger models (up to 70B parameters). Ultimately, PRISM highlights how auxiliary supervision from compressed models and multilingual data can uncover and mitigate hazardous tool-calling behaviors across different model families. We release all experimental code and supporting artifacts at this https URL, alongside an interactive explorer of recorded model responses and experimental results at this https URL.

[NLP-142] When Reasoning Traces Conflict with Evidence: How Answer Configuration Shapes Evidence Following

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在复杂问答任务中因推理轨迹（reasoning trace）与当前证据之间存在冲突时，导致模型无法正确遵循最新证据的问题。其核心挑战在于：推理轨迹既能提升准确性，也可能在与新证据矛盾时干扰模型对最新信息的采纳。为分离这两种作用，研究通过交叉验证不同版本的证据与由模型生成的推理轨迹，在两种配置下进行测试——即延续模型自身思考（continuation）与独立答案调用（separate answer call）。实验结果表明，独立调用相比延续推理显著提升了对当前证据的遵循程度，增幅达29.9至60.6个百分点；而在两种配置下，移除推理轨迹均导致准确率下降相当幅度，说明轨迹对性能具有双重影响。进一步分析显示，推理轨迹的价值主要集中在最后一行，初始黄金证据在轨迹生成前最具影响力，而干扰项会削弱独立调用下的修正能力；此外，重新推理（renewed reasoning）相较于仅提供验证指令，更能有效引导模型在冲突情境下采纳当前证据。因此，推理轨迹的“有益性”与“可被信赖性”是两个独立属性，不能仅通过删除轨迹来判断模型依赖的是何种信息源。论文强调，评估应同时报告模型的答案配置、轨迹的使用方式及其对证据遵循的倾向性，以全面揭示模型行为机制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20805
作者: Shaoang Li,Yanhang Shi,Jian Li
机构: Stony Brook University (石溪大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 25 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A reasoning trace retained at answer time plays two roles: it can raise accuracy, and it can compete with the current evidence when the two disagree. We disentangle these roles by crossing verified evidence versions with the traces generated from each and answering from the same traces and evidence under two configurations: continuation of the model’s own thinking and a separate answer call. Across three model families (gpt-oss, Gemma4, Qwen3) on HotpotQA and MuSiQue, the separate call raises evidence-following over continuation by 29.9 to 60.6 points. On the same pairs, removing the trace lowers accuracy by similar amounts under both configurations. Yet continuation repeats the stale conclusion in most conflicts, and the separate call follows the current evidence far more often. Benefiting from a trace and deferring to it are therefore distinct properties. Further analyses show that the final line of a trace carries most of its value, gold evidence helps most before the trace is written, distractors weaken correction under a separate call, and renewed reasoning, unlike a verification instruction, follows the current evidence in most conflicts. Because trace deletion alone cannot reveal which source an answer follows, evaluations should report both properties together with the answer configuration.

[NLP-143] APRiL: An Open-ended Benchmark for Chinese Social Awareness in Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在中文社会交互场景中缺乏全面社会意识评估能力的问题。现有基准测试通常局限于特定社会能力、任务形式或交互情境，难以覆盖多样化语境下的社会认知需求。为此，研究提出APRiL——一个面向中文社会意识的开放式评估基准，其关键在于引入实例特定的评分标准（instance-specific rubrics），并设计了两个互补任务：社会情景分析（Social Scenario Analysis）用于评估模型对社会线索、心理状态及冲突结构的理解能力，社会适切响应（Socially Aware Response）则考察模型能否将上述理解转化为恰当且自然的回应。实验结果揭示了12个来自六个模型家族的普遍“理解-回应”差距现象，即高质量的情景分析可提升回应质量，而低质量分析反而会降低表现。因此，该研究的核心贡献在于构建了一个系统化、多维度的社会意识评估框架，推动中文环境下具备社会感知能力的语言模型发展。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20785
作者: Tian Lan,Han Zhang,Shanshan Wang,Yahan Yu,Jiang Li,Yugo Murawaki
机构: Kyoto University (京都大学); Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学); University of Macau (澳门大学); The University of Tokyo (东京大学); Inner Mongolia University (内蒙古大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 26 pages, 9 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models are increasingly used in social interactions, where appropriate responses require recognizing implicit cues, inferring mental states, identifying conflicts, and considering potential consequences. However, existing benchmarks often focus on specific social abilities, constrained task formats, or particular interaction settings, offering limited coverage of social awareness across diverse contexts. To address this gap, we introduce APRiL, an open-ended benchmark for Chinese social awareness with instance-specific rubrics. APRiL contains 2,196 Social Awareness Evaluation Instances across six categories and two complementary tasks: Social Scenario Analysis evaluates models’ understanding of social cues, mental states, and conflict structures, while Socially Aware Response assesses whether they can translate this understanding into appropriate, natural responses. Experiments on 12 models from six families reveal a consistent understanding-to-response gap. Higher-quality scenario analyses improve responses, while weak analyses may reduce response quality. APRiL provides a systematic resource for advancing socially aware language models in Chinese contexts. Our data and code are available at this https URL.

[NLP-144] ARIA: Runtime Inspection and Amendment for Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）驱动的多智能体系统（Multi-Agent System, MAS）中局部错误传播导致任务失败的问题。在现有方法中，错误通常仅能在任务完成后通过诊断或反复重执行来修正，缺乏在运行过程中实时干预的能力。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为Agent Runtime Inspection and Amendment (ARIA) 的框架，核心思想是将执行验证后的修复过程转化为可复用的监督信号，从而将修复搜索从运行时测试转变为数据构建与模型训练。研究首先构建了首个大规模、面向失败多智能体轨迹与执行验证修复对的公开数据集——ARIA数据集，包含3,953个经验证的修复样本，明确标注了故障原因、干预位置及后续执行修正方式。基于此数据集，训练一个轻量级模型以实现对运行中多智能体系统的实时检测与修正，目标是学习具有泛化能力的修复策略，而非简单复制特定修复操作。实验表明，经过训练的ARIA模型在事后修复与实时干预场景下均表现出色，并能有效推广至未见过的多智能体框架和主机模型。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20780
作者: Bolin Shen,Yushun Dong
机构: Florida State University (佛罗里达州立大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS), a local mistake can propagate as other agents build on it, turning a correctable error into a failed task. Diagnosing completed runs or repeatedly re-executing them to search for corrections does not provide a learned policy for intervening while execution is still in progress. We present Agent Runtime Inspection and Amendment (ARIA), a framework for learning when and how to repair ongoing multi-agent executions. Our key intuition is to turn execution-verified repairs into reusable supervision, moving repair search into data construction and training so that a learned model can intervene at runtime without repeatedly testing alternatives. First, we collect over 24,000 successful and failed trajectories across four multi-agent frameworks, six benchmarks, and eight host models. From these trajectories, we construct the ARIA dataset, to our knowledge the first large-scale dataset pairing failed multi-agent trajectories with execution-verified repairs. It contains 3,953 verified repair pairs, each specifying what went wrong, where to intervene, and how execution should continue. Then, we develop the ARIA framework for MAS-agnostic runtime inspection and amendment, designed to integrate with any MAS that exposes execution trajectories and supports continuation replacement. Using verified repairs as training examples, we teach a compact model to recognize when intervention is needed and how to correct an ongoing run. The aim is to learn repair strategies that apply to related failures in new configurations, rather than merely reproduce individual corrections. Finally, the trained ARIA model demonstrates strong repair performance in both post-hoc and runtime settings, with generalization to unseen frameworks and host models. Our code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-145] Verdict: Encode Once Decide Many

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决组织工作中大量细粒度、类型化决策任务的自动化问题，即在无需人工干预的前提下，对单一状态（如一封邮件）针对多个具体问题（如是否需要回复、紧急程度、负责人等）进行高置信度判断。传统方法如标准交叉编码器（cross-encoder）需对每个问题单独遍历输入，效率低下且难以扩展。本文提出Verdict-MQ，一种开放式编码器架构，其核心创新在于通过一次读取案例并利用结构化注意力掩码（structured attention mask），实现对所有问题的并行回答。该设计确保在截断后保留的状态令牌一致的前提下，状态编码与问题无关，问题间互不干扰，且选项顺序不影响结果，从而在理论上保障了输出的不变性。实验表明，395M规模的Verdict-MQ在类型化决策基准上显著优于421M的Laya专用模型，在五组新种子下均更接近软黄金标签（KL 0.080 vs 0.117，Brier 0.045 vs 0.061），且优势在温度缩放后仍保持；其更高准确率（0.801 vs 0.767）超出基准饱和点，暗示更贴近标注教师的判断。在RACE、BoolQ和MultiRC等通用问答任务中，尽管在部分数据集上表现逊于微调基线，但其零样本性能超越所有微调编码器，甚至超过封闭通用系统（Jev）。控制实验进一步揭示共享状态带来的成本：为每个问题分配独立的状态感知副本可提升RACE和MultiRC得分0.9–3.5分，但代价是1.4–2.5倍的每案例延迟，而在类型化决策任务中无明显收益，验证了所提架构在效率与一致性上的优越性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20778
作者: Avdhesh Singh Chouhan,Jack Perry
机构: LEC AI(LEC AI)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 19 pages, 2 figures, 14 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automating organizational work means answering many small typed questions about one piece of state (does this email need a reply, how urgent is it, who owns it) with probabilities good enough to act on without a human. The open typed-decision model we compare against, like a standard cross-encoder, answers each question with a separate pass over the input. We present Verdict-MQ, an open encoder that reads a case once and answers all of its questions: given identical retained state tokens after truncation (verified on every reported case), a structured attention mask makes the state encoding independent of the questions, keeps questions from influencing each other, and makes option order irrelevant by construction. On the typed-decisions benchmark, a 395M Verdict-MQ matches the soft gold labels significantly better than the released 421M Laya specialist on all five fresh seeds (KL 0.080 vs 0.117, Brier 0.045 vs 0.061), an advantage that survives per-system temperature scaling; its higher accuracy (0.801 vs 0.767) lies past the benchmark’s own saturation point, so we read that margin as closer agreement with the benchmark’s labelling teacher. On RACE, BoolQ and MultiRC, against a matched fine-tuned baseline it wins on MultiRC and loses on RACE and on BoolQ, where its training is unstable; we measure zero-shot references ourselves, including a closed general system (Jev) that beats every fine-tuned encoder. A controlled comparison measures what the shared state costs: giving each question its own question-aware copy of the state gains 0.9-3.5 points on RACE and MultiRC at 1.4-2.5x the per-case latency, and nothing measurable on typed decisions, with the invariance guarantees unchanged.

[NLP-146] Reference-Guided Turn-Taking Style Transfer for Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models ICASSP2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语音对话模型在全双工（full-duplex）交互中缺乏灵活、可调控的发言主动性（initiative）问题。现有方法通常依赖外部控制或无法量化模型发言程度，导致难以精确调节模型的对话参与度。其核心解决方案是识别出一个关键变量——倡议向量（initiative vector），即模型内部晚期残差流（late-layer residual-stream）中的单一方向，该方向直接编码了模型决定是否抢话的内在倾向。该向量可通过模型自身对话数据提取，无需额外训练或标注。通过在生成过程中对倡议向量进行缩放，可显著调控模型的发言比例，从原始的21–30%提升至42–61%，且效果稳定跨对话场景、模型权重与语料库。此外，仅需一段简短的参考音频即可将特定说话者的轮次风格迁移至模型，且该迁移具有高度参考特异性：更换参考源后93–98%情况下匹配度下降，而统一剂量则无显著差异。这表明，轮次控制并非固化于模型权重，而是可读取、可调整并按个体校准的动态方向。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20763
作者: Yuxuan Chen,Yang Xiao,Jack Sun,Chak Sun,Brick Li, Sam
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Sound (cs.SD)
备注: 5 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Audio examples: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Full-duplex spoken language models decide at every frame whether to take the floor, defining a conversational personality – yet each set of weights encodes exactly one, which human speakers bracket rather than share. Existing controls mostly act from outside; none identifies the quantity that sets how much the model speaks. We identify it: a single late-layer residual-stream direction, the initiative vector, extracted from the model’s own conversations without training or annotation. The same direction reads the decision, anticipating onsets up to 800 ms ahead, and shifts it: scaled during generation, it moves speech ratio from 6-12% to 42-61% (no steering: 21-30%), consistently across conversations, weights, and corpora. A short reference recording suffices to transfer a speaker’s turn-taking style to the model, and the transfer is reference-specific: swapping in another speaker’s reference worsens the match in 93-98% of cases, whereas the best uniform dose is indistinguishable from no steering. Turn-taking style is not frozen into the weights but a direction that can be read, shifted, and calibrated per person. Audio examples are available at this https URL.

[NLP-147] urboMamba: Faster Inference Faster Training and Better Prediction with Lexical Memory

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在推理与训练过程中效率低下及生成精度不足的问题，尤其针对传统Mamba架构在长序列建模中全局上下文利用不充分、局部预测能力弱的缺陷。其核心解决方案在于提出一种混合架构——TurboMamba：在每完成一个token块后，由一个全局Mamba-3模型统一处理该块的上下文信息，随后通过一个小型Transformer结合全局上下文与块内历史token进行精细化的下一个token预测。为增强局部预测性能，引入三项轻量化改进：直接访问前一块的最后一个token以增强时序连贯性、对下一个token得分施加小规模校正、以及基于近期token频率学习得到的加权混合机制。实验在公共数据集FineWeb-Edu上对比了12种参数量相当且训练预算一致的小规模模型，包括Transformer、Mamba-3、Jamba和Zamba（后者以Mamba-3替代原模块）。结果表明，TurboMamba在平均测试预测损失（负对数似然，NLL）上优于所有基线模型，较Mamba-3降低9.4%，较Jamba版本降低7.3%，较Zamba版本降低18.3%；同时，在端到端训练吞吐率方面达到Mamba-3的2.60倍、Jamba版本的2.81倍、Zamba版本的4.82倍；在批量为32、提示长度256 token、生成长度128 token的典型工作负载下，端到端延迟速度提升分别达3.12倍、3.53倍和6.21倍。因此，该方案的关键创新在于通过分层结构融合Mamba的高效长程建模能力与Transformer的精细局部预测优势，并辅以轻量级优化，实现了性能与效率的双重突破。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20682
作者: Hanxin Zhang
机构: University of Pittsburgh(匹兹堡大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We introduce TurboMamba, a language-model architecture for faster inference, faster training, and better token prediction. A global Mamba-3 model runs once per completed token block. A small Transformer uses this global context and earlier tokens within the block to predict the next token. Three lightweight additions improve local predictions: direct access to the previous block’s last token, a small correction to next-token scores, and a learned mixture with recent-token frequencies. We compare twelve small-scale implementations on public FineWeb-Edu, with comparable parameter counts and shared training-budget caps. The baselines include Transformer, Mamba-3, Jamba, and Zamba. The Jamba and Zamba versions use Mamba-3 in place of their original Mamba modules. TurboMamba achieves the lowest mean test prediction loss (negative log-likelihood, NLL) among all twelve models. Its mean NLL is 9.4% lower than that of Mamba-3, 7.3% lower than that of the Jamba version, and 18.3% lower than that of the Zamba version. End-to-end training throughput is 2.60x that of Mamba-3, 2.81x that of the Jamba version, and 4.82x that of the Zamba version. We measure end-to-end batch latency for a batch of 32 sequences, each with a 256-token prompt and 128 generated tokens. On this workload, TurboMamba achieves a 3.12x speedup over Mamba-3, a 3.53x speedup over the Jamba version, and a 6.21x speedup over the Zamba version.

[NLP-148] CascadeLedger: Counterfactual Auditing of Information and Resource Integrity in LLM Cascades

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决预算约束下的语言模型级联系统中，由于路由决策依赖不可观测信息而导致的可审计性与透明性缺失问题。现有系统在执行过程中难以验证其决策是否基于合法可观测输入，且无法有效检测隐蔽读取（hidden-read）或资源使用偏差等故障，从而影响系统的可信度与可复现性。其核心解决方案是提出CascadeLedger框架，通过引入“反事实执行-审计”机制，确保执行过程满足“调用前读取”语义，并将成功读取绑定至服务与缓存身份，精确记录可用性及组件级预算状态变迁。该方案的关键在于构建“聚合等价的轨迹有效性”概念，即两个执行路径即使最终答案、资源预估和各服务调用分布一致，但若其路由决策使用了未公开的隐藏信息，则判定为无效。进一步地，通过引入反事实前缀非干扰性（Counterfactual Prefix Non-Interference, CPNI），在保持可见前缀不变的前提下，仅改变声明的隐藏家族，以识别最小违反前缀与隐式证据；同时采用投影保持对抗性变异（Projection-Preserving Adversarial Mutation, PPAM）方法，探测那些对非反事实检查器仍具欺骗性的无效轨迹。实验表明，该双层审计机制在冻结缓存、独立生成与服务评估场景下均实现了0.0%的误报率，能够检测99.83%的串行化故障与99.82%的未记录隐藏读取故障，并在确定性重计算后修正34.03%的错误质量-资源结论，具备高精度与强鲁棒性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20668
作者: Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao
机构: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (中国科学院大学); Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences (中国科学院信息工程研究所)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 38 pages, 6 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We introduce CascadeLedger, a counterfactual execution-audit framework for budgeted language-model cascades. The protocol enforces call-before-read semantics, binds successful reads to service and cache identities, records availability and component-wise budget transitions, and freezes the event trace before any target or task scorer is joined. The central object is aggregate-equivalent trace validity: two executions can share a final answer, declared resource projection, and service histogram while differing in whether their routing decisions used only legitimately observable information. We complement single-trace invariants with counterfactual prefix non-interference (CPNI), which couples a visible prefix and policy randomness while changing only a declared hidden family. The counterfactual influence frontier (CIF) localizes the earliest violating prefix and a minimal hidden witness; projection-preserving adversarial mutation (PPAM) searches for invalid traces that remain acceptable to a non-counterfactual checker. Across frozen-cache, independently generated, and serving evaluations, the two-layer audit reports a clean false-positive rate of 0.0000, detects 0.9983 of serialized faults and 0.9982 of unlogged hidden-read faults, and changes 0.3403 of corrupted quality-resource conclusions after deterministic recomputation. The online recorder and offline CPNI audit have separate overhead measurements. Learned routing and semantic verification provide downstream compatibility studies under the same execution contract.

[NLP-149] Does Personalization Break Trust? Open-Set Rejection Calibration Under Few-Shot On-Device Intent Adaptation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）在设备端通过少样本微调（如LoRA）实现个性化时所面临的“域外输入拒绝”（out-of-scope, OOS）识别能力退化问题。尽管现有方法能有效提升对新用户指令的识别准确率（in-scope accuracy），但其在识别与所有已知意图均不匹配的输入（即域外输入）方面表现显著下降，导致系统误将未知请求当作已知意图处理，带来安全隐患和用户体验恶化。研究发现，采用朴素的少样本LoRA微调会使五个公开意图分类基准上的OOS拒绝AUROC平均下降0.055至0.258，且此现象并非由评分器校准偏差完全解释——尽管标准置信度评分器本身在适应过程中出现校准偏移，仍存在真实存在的性能衰减，其根源可归因于已知意图区域嵌入空间边际（embedding margin）的可测量收缩（pooled Spearman rho=0.61）。为此，论文提出一种部署成本极低的解决方案：改用马氏距离（Mahalanobis distance）进行拒绝决策，无需额外训练或重训即可在三个数据集上恢复大部分丢失的OOS识别性能，优于两种现有的基于分布外检测（OOD）的评分基线，并展现出对样本数量、LoRA秩及不同主干编码器的良好泛化能力。作者同时坦诚该方案的局限性，并开源全部代码以确保可复现性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20652
作者: Vaibhav Prajapati,Pushp Garg
机构: University of Technology Nuremberg (德国纽伦堡应用技术大学); Indian Institute of Information Sri City (印度信息学院斯里城校区)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Always-on virtual assistants increasingly personalize on-device to new user-specific commands via few-shot fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), but this adaptation is evaluated almost exclusively on whether it learns the new commands, not on whether the assistant can still recognize an input that matches none of its intents - the out-of-scope (OOS) rejection problem. We show that naive few-shot LoRA personalization degrades OOS-rejection AUROC (area under the ROC curve) on every one of five public intent-classification benchmarks (mean drop 0.055 – 0.258 , five seeds each), while in-scope accuracy is preserved. A scorer-invariant check shows part of this drop is an artifact of the standard confidence scorer’s own miscalibration under adaptation, though a smaller, genuine effect remains under any scorer; we trace it to a measurable shrinkage of the embedding margin around known-intent regions (pooled Spearman rho=0.61 ). A deployment-cheap fix is scoring rejection by Mahalanobis distance instead of softmax confidence without extra training/retraining recovers most of the lost quality on 3 of 5 datasets at no accuracy cost, beats two further OOD scoring baselines, and generalizes across shot count, LoRA rank, and a second base encoder. We report honestly where the fix falls short and release all code for reproducibility.

[NLP-150] CoTS: Competitive Token Selection for Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有隐式推理（latent reasoning）方法在解码过程中对连续软表示与离散承诺之间动态平衡能力不足的问题。具体而言，虽然当前方法通过使用连续软嵌入或隐藏状态来增强中间表示并保留多种可能的推理路径，但其对隐式干预的处理方式仍为全局软激活或基于不确定性阈值的硬切换，未能实现按解码步骤自适应调节干预强度的连续控制。为此，论文提出一种无需训练的框架——竞争性标记选择（Competitive Token Selection, CoTS），其核心创新在于将原本二元化的隐式干预模式重构为基于令牌级别的连续分配机制。CoTS利用概率上最相近的两个候选生成项之间的竞争关系，动态权衡每一步的离散确定性与软探索程度：当主导项明显优于次优项时，模型倾向于保持离散采样轨迹以维持推理稳定性；而当二者竞争加剧时，则增加软表示的贡献以保留潜在备选路径。该机制无需人工设定切换阈值或混合系数，且不引入额外前向传播开销。在六个推理基准上的实验表明，CoTS在性能上持续优于标准Chain-of-Thought（CoT）及当前最先进的无训练隐式推理方法。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20642
作者: Jie Yu,Yuxi Sun,Zhaoxu Li,Chunxiao Liu,Xudong Jiang
机构: Xiaomi AI Lab(小米人工智能实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent latent reasoning methods move beyond discrete Chain-of-Thought (CoT) by replacing sampled tokens with continuous soft embeddings or hidden states, enabling richer intermediate representations and preserving alternative reasoning paths. However, the need for latent reasoning varies across decoding steps: confident predictions favor discrete commitment, whereas ambiguous steps benefit from preserving multiple plausible alternatives. Existing approaches typically handle this variation through either global soft activation or hard switching based on uncertainty thresholds, treating latent intervention as an all-or-nothing decision rather than continuously adapting its strength. To address this limitation, we propose Competitive Token Selection (CoTS), a training-free framework that reframes latent intervention from binary mode selection into continuous allocation at the token level. CoTS uses the probability competition between the two most likely candidates to dynamically balance discrete commitment and soft exploration at each reasoning step. The second candidate represents the strongest alternative to the model’s preferred continuation, so the separation between the two directly reflects the stability of the current discrete choice. When one candidate clearly dominates, CoTS keeps the representation close to the sampled discrete token to preserve a stable reasoning trajectory; as the competition strengthens, it increases the contribution of the soft representation to retain plausible alternatives. This competition-based allocation requires neither manually tuned switching thresholds nor mixing coefficients, and introduces no additional forward passes. Experiments across six reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that CoTS consistently outperforms standard CoT and state-of-the-art training-free latent reasoning methods. Our code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-151] AbridgeKV: Compressing Long Reasoning into the KV Cache of Learned Pause Tokens

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长链式推理（long chain-of-thought decoding）过程中因持续生成文本而导致的键值缓存（KV cache）内存占用线性增长的问题。传统方法通过淘汰缓存条目来缓解内存压力，但无法有效提升模型在未经过此类淘汰训练时的生成长度与性能。为此，本文提出AbridgeKV方案，其核心在于训练模型自身对输出内容进行压缩：将已生成文本块压缩为少数可学习的“暂停标记”（pause tokens），这些标记作为额外输入但不产生输出，其键值（KV）嵌入编码原块信息；随后释放原始缓存空间，后续生成过程直接关注这些压缩后的暂停标记的KV条目。关键创新点包括：暂停标记的KV位置嵌入于其所替代的文本块内部、按各层缓存条目实际价值动态分配缓存预算、以及基于较大文本块执行压缩操作。在包含446道竞赛题目的多数据集测试中，仅保留四分之一原始缓存容量的AbridgeKV模型在准确率和生成长度上达到全量缓存模型水平，显著优于同类先进淘汰策略（evictor）和重新训练的压缩器（compressor）。部署于vLLM框架下，序列级缓存规模缩小3.5倍，饱和状态下的H100显卡处理时间加快3.2倍。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20641
作者: Jack Cai,Lijie Yang,Vasilis Kontonis,Dimitris Papailiopoulos,Shivam Garg
机构: Princeton University (普林斯顿大学); Microsoft Research (微软研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long chain-of-thought decoding is memory-bound: the KV cache of the generated tokens grows linearly with the test-time compute being spent. Evicting cache entries does not fix this, because a model never trained on a cache with entries removed generates longer, often up to the length limit. We instead train the model to compress its own output. AbridgeKV compresses each completed block of generated text into the KV entries of a few learned pause tokens. These are extra input tokens with trained embeddings that produce no output. Once the pause tokens have encoded the block, AbridgeKV frees the block’s original cache; subsequent tokens attend to the pause tokens’ KV entries in its place. Three novel choices make this work: the pause tokens’ KV entries take positions inside the block they replace, the cache budget is allocated across layers according to the measured value of each layer’s entries, and compression operates on relatively large blocks. On 446 competition problems from AIME, HMMT, AMC, BRUMO, CMIMC and SMT with 32K-token generations, keeping a quarter of the generated cache matches an identically trained full-KV model in accuracy and output length; the strongest published evictor at a matched budget writes far longer, and the closest trained compressor, retrained on the same data, loses 10 points. Served in vLLM, the cache is 3.5x smaller per sequence and a saturated H100 finishes a problem 3.2x faster than with full KV.

[NLP-152] Same Answer New Box: How Much of RLVRs Out-of-Domain Gain Is Answer Format?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决强化学习中可验证奖励（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards, RLVR）在跨领域评估中报告的性能提升是否真实反映了模型能力增强，还是仅源于答案格式优化的问题。具体而言，现有评估方法依赖于外部答案提取器（answer extractor）从模型输出中自动抽取答案，而这些提取器往往优先检索特定格式的位置（如数学题中的\boxed{}标记），导致模型通过将答案置于指定位置即可获得更高评分，而非真正提升推理或回答质量。论文的关键发现在于：在多个7B规模的基线-强化学习模型对中，高达82%的跨领域多项选择题性能增益实际上源自答案格式的改变，而非答案内容本身的改进——即模型只是将原本已存在于文本中的答案移至\boxed{}中以迎合提取器偏好。作者设计了一种新的、更鲁棒的提取器，能够识别任意位置的答案（无论是否在\boxed{}内），并重新评估已有输出，结果表明大部分“增益”消失。此外，使用独立的大语言模型（LLM）作为阅读器进行验证，也得到相似结论（77%的增益为格式所致）。而在一个32B模型对中，由于基线模型本就习惯使用框式格式，而强化学习模型反而减少使用，因此几乎不存在格式性增益，说明该现象具有模型和训练策略依赖性。综上，论文揭示了当前评估范式中存在的严重偏差，并指出：报告的性能增益部分是提取器特性的产物，其本质可通过重用已有输出并更换提取器来量化，无需重新执行强化学习过程。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20639
作者: Zongye Lyu
机构: Monash University (莫纳什大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 36 pages (10 main), 5 figures, 28 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is credited with gains beyond the domain its rewards check, such as higher MMLU accuracy after training on mathematics. Such accuracies are usually read out of the model’s text by an answer extractor. A model that learns to write its answer where the extractor looks can therefore score higher without answering better. We measure how much of the gain reported by extractors copied from public code arises this way. We generate outputs from a base model and its RL model and score them twice: with those extractors, and with one extractor of our own that reads a stated answer whether it is in the answer box \boxed or in the text. On four released 7B SimpleRL base-RL pairs, 82% of the out-of-domain multiple-choice gain that these extractors report disappears under ours: it is a gain in answer format, not in answers. The base models already state most of their answers in text, and RL moves them into the box, where these extractors look first. Independent LLM readers, in place of our extractor, put the figure at 77%. With a prompt that itself asks for the box, our extractor puts it at 79%. On a 32B pair trained with another recipe, almost none of the reported gain is format gain: its base model boxes its answers when asked, and its RL model rarely does when not. A reported gain is partly a property of the extractor that read it, and re-scoring stored outputs with a second extractor shows how much, without re-running RL.

[NLP-153] Exploring the Design Space of Permutation Diffusion LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于语言模型生成排列（permutation generation）时面临的双重挑战：一是文本条件下的候选项排序（text-conditioned ranking），二是候选项与输出位置之间的全局一一映射（global one-to-one assignment）。其核心解决方案的关键在于通过三种不同的扩散-语言模型（diffusion-LLM）参数化方式来建模排列约束：1）在打乱的候选索引序列上进行硬分配预测；2）在双随机矩阵（doubly stochastic matrices）上进行软分配预测；3）直接预测排序得分并随后进行排序。这三种方法将排列约束施加于不同阶段的预测与解码过程，从而支持各异的训练目标与采样策略。实验结果表明，在亚马逊三个领域的推荐重排序任务中，候选集规模为10和20时，硬分配与软分配变体在单次函数评估下达到与受限掩码扩散基线相当的Recall@1性能，而直接排序得分预测无需匈牙利算法或Sinkhorn归一化即可保证有效排列。然而，增加函数评估次数并未一致提升排序质量，且效果高度依赖状态表示与训练目标设计。研究结论强调：在基于语言模型去噪器的排列扩散框架中，噪声扰动（corruption）、预测参数化、优化目标与解码器必须协同设计才能实现最优性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20635
作者: Zhe Xu,Mingfu Liang,Kavosh Asadi,Jean-Pascal Billaud,Tianyi Chen,Yanhui Guo,Christina Huang,Baekjin Kim,Jimmy Kim,Yufei Li,Daqi Sun,Jiachen Sun,Dian Yu,Zaiwei Zhang,Kaushik Rangadurai,Frank Shyu,Sandeep Pandey,Xi Liu,Luke Simon
机构: Meta
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Permutation generation with language models requires both text-conditioned ranking and a global one-to-one assignment between candidates and output positions. We study this problem through three diffusion-LLM parameterizations: hard-assignment prediction over shuffled candidate-index sequences, soft-assignment prediction over doubly stochastic matrices, and direct ordering-score prediction followed by sorting. The three families place permutation constraints at different stages of prediction and decoding and therefore support different training objectives and sampling procedures. We evaluate these designs on recommendation reranking across three Amazon domains with candidate sets of size 10 and 20. At one function evaluation, the hard- and soft-assignment variants achieve Recall@1 comparable to a constrained masked-diffusion baseline, whereas direct ordering-score prediction guarantees valid permutations without Hungarian assignment or Sinkhorn normalization. Additional function evaluations do not consistently improve ranking quality, and their effect depends strongly on the state representation and training objective. These results show that corruption, prediction parameterization, objective, and decoder should be designed jointly for permutation diffusion with language-model denoisers.

[NLP-154] Jev-as-a-Judge for RAG Claim Verification: Confidence-Gated Cascading Between a Non-Generative Verifier and a Frontier LLM

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）系统中冗余的文本生成开销问题，即在执行二元判断任务（如“该证据是否支持该主张”）时，主流流程仍依赖生成式模型输出完整文本以获取单一比特的决策结果，导致高昂的计算成本。其核心解决方案是引入一种非生成式判别模型，该模型直接返回预定义枚举类型的分类结果（如“支持”或“不支持”），并附带原生概率值，而无需生成任何自然语言文本。关键创新在于：通过对比一个低成本、非生成式的判别模型与前沿大语言模型（LLM）在相同标注数据集（LLM-AggreFact）上的表现，发现二者在标准评估指标上统计无显著差异，但前者成本仅为后者的1/187。进一步分析揭示，尽管整体准确率相近，两模型在错误模式上存在异质性，且廉价模型对未被支持主张的误判率更高（23.2% vs 14.1%），表明传统指标掩盖了实际部署中的风险差异。最终提出一种基于置信度的分级处理策略——将高置信度判断由廉价模型直接处理，低置信度样本交由昂贵模型处理，实现74.10的得分仅需2.92美元/千条，显著优于全量使用昂贵模型的8.93美元/千条，但实验显示成本节约主要源于“升迁比例”而非概率阈值本身，说明效率提升来自策略设计而非模型内在能力。研究强调，在追求准确率的同时必须关注错误分布的不对称性，真正的优化应基于对不同错误模式的理解与组合。所有代码、提示模板及定价数据均已开源。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20634
作者: Alden Do Rosario,Kirollos Atef
机构: CustomGPT.ai(自定义GPT.ai)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 31 pages, 6 figures. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Retrieval-augmented generation asks one question at volume: does this evidence support this claim? The answer is one bit, yet most pipelines obtain it from a text generator and pay generation prices for the prose wrapped around it. We compare a non-generative decision model, which returns a typed value from a declared enumeration together with a native probability and no text, against a frontier LLM configured as an engineer would deploy it for binary classification. Both answer the same 495 human-labelled claims from LLM-AggreFact, so every comparison is within-item. We report three things. First, the two systems are statistically indistinguishable on the metric this task is conventionally scored by, a paired difference of -0.56 points, Jev minus Astra, at a 187-fold cost difference. Second, that tie carries almost no information about deployment: the systems disagree on 15.2% of claims, and the cheaper one admits 23.2% of the claims annotators marked unsupported against the frontier model’s 14.1%. A component whose job is to catch unsupported claims should be judged on that rate, and the conventional headline hides it. Third, because the errors differ they compose: routing the claims the cheap model is confident about and escalating the rest reaches 74.10 at USD 2.92 per thousand claims against 73.83 at USD 8.93, with the threshold chosen out of fold. But a matched random-escalation control at in-sample thresholds, spending the same budget by coin flip, does as well, so what buys the saving is the escalation share and not the probability that picks what to escalate. Measured against the cheap model it is built from, the cascade costs 61-fold more for 0.83 points, 95% CI [-3.36, 4.86], and it is the more permissive guard of the two. Equal accuracy conceals unequal errors. All predictions, prompts, pricing and code are released.

[NLP-155] Context Injection and Long-Horizon Reliability: Separating Duplicate Recognition Local Processing and Counter Tracking

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在长时序任务中出现的渐进性失效问题，特别是针对其在长时间跨度下对历史信息的准确记忆与状态维护能力不足的缺陷。传统评估方法通常仅关注最终任务成功率或可维持的上下文长度，而本文提出一种细粒度、分步评分的400步记账任务（ledger task），将任务分解为三个可独立评估的组件：对早期记录的长距离识别（duplicate recognition）、当前记录的局部处理（local processing）以及每步递增的计数器（counter）维护。其解决方案的关键在于通过模块化评估揭示各组件在长周期中的行为差异——结果显示，尽管局部处理和计数器在无干扰条件下表现稳定（计数器连续8000步无错误），但重复识别错误在第200步后显著上升（从0.0019增至0.011/步），且主要由长距离回忆失败和误报共同导致；更重要的是，仅在每个步骤前插入一段无关内容块即导致计数器在全部20个种子实验中均发生失败，表明模型状态维护极易受外部干扰影响。进一步预注册分析表明，计数器值依赖于响应历史中的先前值，一旦被污染则无法自我修正，而外部精确的状态提醒（oracle-supplied compact reminder）可在一到两步内恢复计数器正确性，且优于等长中性文本，提示模型缺乏内在纠错机制。该研究强调了聚合误差分类可能掩盖关键组件间的异质性失效模式，凸显了对长时序推理中状态一致性与抗干扰能力进行精细化建模的重要性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20633
作者: Thomas Serval
机构: Baracoda AI Labs; NEOMA Business School (NEOMA商学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 17 pages, 5 figures. Code, data and reproduction script: this https URL (tag v1.0-arxiv)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-horizon failures of language models are usually measured as end-task success or as a horizon length. We instead score, step by step, three components of a 400-step ledger task in which every step is easy in isolation and the model’s own answers are re-injected into its context: recognising a record already seen 5 to 300 steps earlier, processing the current record locally, and writing a counter incremented at every step. On Qwen3-8B (non-thinking, 20 seeds, replicated on a second machine and backend), with every step scored component by component, two results hold. First, duplicate-recognition errors rise late in the episode – from 0.0019 to 0.011 per step at risk across step 200 – while the counter makes no error in 8,000 steps and local processing is descriptively stable; the rise combines long-distance recall errors and rising false alarms. Second, a block of irrelevant content inserted before each step makes the counter fail in 20 of 20 seeds on each machine, against none without it, while its effect on local processing is much smaller and not distinguishable from none. Three pre-registered follow-ups probe the counter. Its value depends on the value present in the response history: a corrupted value persists without correction in every seed, and an exact external reminder, repeated before each message, re-aligns it within one to two steps. Under the irrelevant block, no counter error was observed when an exact compact reminder of the state, supplied externally by an oracle, preceded each message (0 of 20 seeds with an error, against 15 without it), and this reminder outperformed a length-matched neutral text; whether a single reminder suffices was not conclusive, and the absence of damage to the other components was not established. An aggregate or exclusive error classification can hide the difference we report.

[NLP-156] MeddeX: A Retrieval-Augmented LLaMA-3 System with Gemini Vision for Evidence-Backed Medical Report Analysis

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现代医疗报告日益复杂化所带来的临床专业人员在时间消耗与解读负担上的双重挑战，尤其是传统人工审阅流程存在效率低、易出错且难以扩展的问题。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个集成多模态能力的医学报告分析系统——MeddeX，该系统通过微调的QLoRA-Llama-3（8B）模型结合检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）机制，并融合多模态Gemini Vision模块，实现对文本型PDF、扫描图像型PDF及直接放射影像的智能混合提取。系统核心创新包括：针对损坏或UTF-16编码文档的新型垃圾文本检测机制、基于报告范围的精准上下文检索、自动化纵向报告对比引擎以及按需触发的自愈式补填流水线。此外，系统采用FastAPI后端与Supabase向量数据库构建端到端架构，显著提升了生成摘要的准确性、简洁性与证据支持度。实验结果表明，相较于基线模型LLaMA3-Med42-8B，MeddeX在ROUGE-1、ROUGE-2、ROUGE-L、BLEU和BERTScore等指标上均有显著提升，验证了领域特定微调与系统级设计优化的有效性，为人工智能辅助临床决策支持提供了可落地、鲁棒性强的技术路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20632
作者: Rajdeep Pandhare,Rohit Kundaikar,Yakub Kojar,Shreyansh Tiwari
机构: Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Technology, Mumbai, India
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注: 6 pages , 3 figures, published in ijsrem

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Modern healthcare generates increasingly complex medical reports that challenge clinical professionals in terms of time and interpretive burden. Manual review processes are slow, error-prone, and difficult to scale. This paper presents MeddeX, a Medical Report Analyzer that combines a QLoRA fine-tuned LLaMA-3 (8B) model with Retrieval-Augmented Gen eration (RAG) and a multimodal Gemini Vision layer to deliver accurate, concise, and evidence-backed summaries of medical documents. The system handles text-native PDFs, scanned image based PDFs, and direct radiological images through an intelligent hybrid extraction pipeline that includes a novel garbage-text detection mechanism for corrupted and UTF-16-encoded doc uments. Beyond single-report QA, MeddeX introduces report scoped retrieval for precise contextual grounding, an automated longitudinal report comparison engine, and a self-healing backfill pipeline that lazily processes legacy documents on demand. A FastAPI backend, Supabase vector store, and this http URL fron tend complete the end-to-end architecture. Evaluation against the base LLaMA3-Med42-8B model demonstrates consistent improvements across ROUGE-1 (+9.2%), ROUGE-2 (+10.0%), ROUGE-L (+11.8%), BLEU (+71.4%), and BERTScore (+0.8%), validating the benefit of domain-specific fine-tuning. MeddeX represents a practical and robust step toward AI-assisted clinical decision support.

[NLP-157] Real-time Chatbot Romance Scam Detection in Stage Classification

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决社交媒体平台上日益严重的“浪漫诈骗”（Romance Scam）问题，尤其针对生成式人工智能（Generative AI）技术使身份伪造更加便捷所带来的挑战。其核心解决方案是基于社会学中的七阶段理论，构建一个通过Line Messaging API实现实时交互的聊天机器人（Chatbot），利用大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）对用户对话进行动态分析，识别诈骗所处的具体阶段。该系统不仅能够及时检测潜在的诈骗行为，还能基于LLM生成针对性的阶段解释与防范建议，从而提升用户的风险意识。其关键创新在于将社会科学理论与大语言模型相结合，实现对诈骗过程的结构化识别与即时干预，具备实际应用价值，可直接部署于真实场景中以降低浪漫诈骗的发生风险。

作者: Yi-cheng Liu,Guan-ru Lai,Yi-cheng Lai,Lyn Chao-ling Chen
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multimedia (cs.MM)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Romance scam has become a serious problem via social media, and the improvement of artificial intelligence enable to fake identify easily. In the study, a chatbot has developed to detect romance scam in real-time through Line Messaging API. Using the seven stage theories in the social science field, the stages of romance scam can be detected through large language model. In addition, once a romance scam is detected, the chatbot provides explanations of the stage and prevention advices through large language model. The contribution of the work provides a practical application, and can be used in real scenario for reducing the risk of romance scam.

[NLP-158] A Large-Scale Dataset for Multi-Class Financial News Classification in Brazilian Portuguese

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决巴西葡萄牙语金融自然语言处理（Financial NLP）系统发展受限于领域特定数据集匮乏的问题。其核心解决方案是构建一个包含约16万篇巴西葡萄牙语金融新闻文章的大规模语料库，并通过人工标注与大语言模型（LLM）弱监督标注相结合的方式，建立初步的多分类任务基准。研究的关键在于评估基于语义相似性的三种方法——余弦相似度、K近邻（K-Nearest Neighbors, KNN）和基于FAISS的最近邻搜索——在跨语言语义嵌入下的表现。实验结果表明，该任务对标签质量与类别分布高度敏感：在人工标注子集上，KNN取得最佳性能（准确率47.3%，F1-score 31.9%），FAISS表现紧随其后；而在LLM生成的弱标注子集上，尽管准确率接近50%，但F1-score骤降至约20%，凸显了标签不平衡与噪声标注的负面影响。研究揭示了高质量人工标注在金融文本分类中的关键作用，为巴西葡萄牙语金融NLP领域的后续研究提供了可复现的基准数据集与方法参考。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20630
作者: Leomax Bandeira,Gabriel Aguiar,Dalton Cézane Gomes Valadares,Luiz Pereira,Helder Fernando de Araújo Oliveira,Gustavo Xavier,Andson M. Balieiro
机构: Federal University of Paraíba, BRA(联邦大学帕拉伊巴分校); Federal University of Campina Grande, BRA(联邦大学坎皮纳格兰德分校); Federal Rural University of Pernambuco, BRA(联邦农村大学伯南布哥分校); Federal University of Pernambuco, BRA(联邦大学伯南布哥分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Paper accepted for presentation at SMC 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The development of Financial Natural Language Processing (NLP) systems for Brazilian Portuguese is hindered by the scarcity of domain-specific datasets. To address this, we present a large-scale corpus of approximately 160,000 Brazilian Portuguese financial news articles collected from web sources. To establish initial benchmarks for a weakly supervised multi-class classification approach based on semantic similarity, we annotated subsets of this corpus both manually and using a Large Language Model (LLM). We evaluated three similarity-based methods – cosine similarity, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and FAISS-based nearest-neighbor search – using multilingual semantic embeddings. Our experiments reveal that the task is highly sensitive to label quality and class distribution. On the manually labeled subset, KNN achieved the best performance (47.3% accuracy, 31.9% F1-score), closely followed by FAISS. Conversely, on the LLM-annotated subset, while accuracy reached approximately 50%, F1-scores dropped to near 20%, highlighting the negative impact of label imbalance and noisy weak annotations. These findings establish foundational baselines for a challenging task, underscoring the critical need for high-quality manual annotations. Ultimately, this dataset and our preliminary results provide a reference point for future research in Brazilian Portuguese Financial NLP.

[NLP-159] PRISM: PRIvileged Sibling-guided Multi-Agent Topology Design

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）的多智能体系统（Multi-Agent Systems, MAS）在复杂任务求解中因协作拓扑结构设计不当而导致的性能瓶颈问题。现有方法虽能从任务查询中学习生成协作拓扑，但其训练依赖于已验证执行结果的图谱语料库，而该语料库仅记录成功解题的拓扑结构，却未提供针对特定任务的偏好排序信息，导致后续监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning, SFT）缺乏对每项任务最优拓扑的指导信号。由此引发的问题是：生成器趋向于学习语料库中频繁出现的拓扑模式，而非根据具体任务需求动态适配最优结构，从而在某些任务上取得性能提升的同时，可能损害其他任务的表现。为解决此问题，本文提出PRISM框架，其核心创新在于通过“特权信息学习”（Learning with Privileged Information, LPI）机制，从同一无排序语料库中恢复每项任务的细粒度优化信号。具体而言，教师模型通过一个零初始化的低秩分支读取一个同任务下另一成功拓扑（即“兄弟图”），该信息在部署时不可用；学生模型则通过自采样轨迹，匹配教师在各决策步骤上的目标输出，从而实现对任务特异性拓扑偏好的隐式学习。实验在六个多样化基准测试上表明，PRISM显著优于所有对比的拓扑设计基线，并且与教师匹配的对照组验证了特权信息对性能提升的关键贡献。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20628
作者: Phuong Tuan Dat,Qi Li,Xinchao Wang
机构: National University of Singapore(新加坡国立大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent systems (MAS) based on large language models (LLMs) have become a powerful way to address complex problems, and their effectiveness depends critically on the collaboration topology that decides which agents participate and how they communicate. Recent work learns to generate this topology from the task query, fitting the generator to corpora of execution-verified graphs. The post-training method for such generators remains a limitation: a corpus lists the graphs that solved a query but never ranks them, leaving continued supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with no per-query preference to exploit. Without such a preference, the generator drifts toward the topologies the corpus contains most often rather than those that suit each query, so a gain on one task can come at a cost on another. We propose PRISM, which recovers per-query signal from the same corpus by learning with privileged information: a teacher reads, through a zero-initialized low-rank branch, a sibling graph that also solved the query and is unavailable at deployment, and the student matches its per-decision targets on trajectories the student samples itself. Across six diverse benchmarks PRISM improves over every topology-design baseline evaluated, and matched-teacher controls support the contribution of privileged query information. Code is available in this link.

[NLP-160] DeepUnfolding_Agent : A Classical_Quantum Adaptive Control API

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决机器学习、联邦学习、量子机器学习及经典-量子混合系统中自适应优化工作流因控制器逻辑嵌入任务特定训练脚本而导致的可复现性差、可重用性低、安全验证困难以及跨执行环境公平比较受限的问题。其核心解决方案是提出DeepUnfolding Agent，一个基于模式驱动（schema-driven）的FastAPI平台，将深度展开的自适应控制逻辑封装为外部软件服务。该框架通过策略注册表（strategy registry）、诊断到状态适配器（diagnostic to state adapter）、控制器工厂（controller factory）、安全防护机制（safety guard）、执行器抽象（executor abstraction）、反馈更新路径（feedback update path）、SQLite持久化层、Docker部署支持及可复现基准测试脚本等组件，实现控制器智能与领域特定执行逻辑的解耦。该架构支持经典、量子感知、混合、Qiskit Aer模拟以及可选的IBM量子硬件执行路径，通过单元测试、模式验证、API测试、安全性测试、编排测试、量子执行测试、检查点测试和Docker部署验证，证明了其在金融、医疗、基因组学、交通、噪声量子模拟及真实量子硬件上的外部用户固定策略与自适应策略对比的有效性。实验结果表明，DeepUnfolding Agent为异构优化工作流提供了一个可重用、可追溯的自适应控制层，其量子实验进一步体现了API级量子控制与硬件可移植性的潜力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20615
作者: Shanika Iroshi Nanayakkara,Shiva Raj Pokhrel
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Adaptive optimization workflows in machine learning, federated learning, quantum machine learning, and hybrid classical quantum systems often embed controller logic directly inside task specific training scripts. This coupling limits reuse, reproducibility, safety validation, and fair comparison across execution environments. This paper presents DeepUnfolding Agent, a schema-driven FastAPI platform that exposes deep unfolded adaptive control as an external software service. External executors register a strategy schema, submit round-level diagnostic variables, receive schema-bounded control actions, execute one optimization round, and return feedback for controller update. The framework separates controller intelligence from domain specific execution through a strategy registry, diagnostic to state adapter, controller factory, safety guard, executor abstraction, feedback update path, SQLite persistence layer, Docker deployment, and reproducible benchmark scripts. The implementation supports classical, quantum-aware, hybrid, Qiskit Aer, and optional IBM quantum processing execution pathways. We validate the software through unit, schema, API, safety, orchestration, Quantum execution, checkpointing, and Docker tests, and demonstrate external user fixed versus adaptive workflows across finance, healthcare, genomics, transport, noisy quantum simulation, and hardware backed IBM Quantum execution. The results show that DeepUnfolding-Agent provides a reusable and traceable adaptive control layer for heterogeneous optimization workflows. Our quantum experiments are interpreted as API level quantum control and hardware portability evidence.

[NLP-161] ruth for Believable AI: Expressed Doubt Provenance and Belief Revision as an Engineerable Stance

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决对话智能体在回应时普遍表现出过度自信、缺乏对信息来源的透明性以及无法显式表达信念修正的问题，即如何在不修改底层语言模型的前提下，通过引入一个行为层来实现对认知状态（epistemic states）的可控表达。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个包含三重机制的行为层：（1）基于每条主张的置信度与类型化信息溯源（typed provenance），（2）基于溯源的表达触发规则（provenance-gated expression rule），以及（3）具备可审计记录与部分抗错误修正能力的持久化信念修订存储（persistent revision store）。实验表明，该架构在合成模型上通过了所有五项测试，且在真实模型中实现了承诺的可审计性保证（100%成立），并能部分区分真实与虚假修正；然而，预设的表达保真度、矛盾分离和溯源边界等指标未能达成。进一步后验分析揭示，基于平均答案词元概率的表达门控表现低于随机水平（AUC 0.41），而基于采样一致性的门控则具有判别能力（AUC 0.66）。最终，采用一致性门控配置并通过独立协议验证的方案满足了对话级操控性和能力等价性标准，并在重抽样对话集上实现复现，但其有效性依赖于选择策略，且当不确定性集中在60个事实时，两项核心标准仍未解决。因此，论文支持的结论限于可构造的审计保障、依赖存储的修正判别能力，以及特定基准与模型下词元概率门控的失效，尚需扩大事实规模以开展人类评估。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26035
作者: Sebastian Cochinescu
机构: University of Bucharest(布加勒斯特大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 17 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Companion framework paper: arXiv:2607.15883 . Code, benchmark, cached model outputs, and result files archived at doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21462986 (code and results) and doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21462988 (benchmark dataset)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Conversational agents often express answers in a uniformly confident register. We test whether expressed uncertainty, provenance-aware assertion, and explicit belief revision can be implemented as a behavior layer over a fixed language model; we do not test believability or trust. The layer combines three epistemic states, per-claim confidence and typed provenance, a provenance-gated expression rule, and a persistent revision store with auditable acknowledgments and partial resistance to false corrections. We evaluate it on a constructed, mechanically scored multi-session benchmark using a synthetic model and Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct. The synthetic instrument passes all five checks. On the real model, acknowledgment soundness, a by-construction guarantee, holds in 100% of cases, and true corrections are accepted more often than false ones (0.44 vs. 0.15 on held beliefs; 0.875 vs. 0.420 including rule-accepted corrections of unheld facts), but the pre-specified expression-fidelity, contradiction-separation, and provenance margins fail. A disclosed post hoc analysis shows that expression gated on mean answer-token probability ranks correctness below chance end to end (AUC 0.41, conversation-clustered), whereas gating on sampling consistency discriminates (AUC 0.66). A consistency-gated configuration selected from this finding and evaluated under a separately committed protocol meets the conversation-level manipulation and capability-equivalence criteria and replicates on a redrawn conversation set. The manipulation result is selection-dependent, and both criteria remain unresolved when uncertainty is clustered over the 60 facts. The supported conclusions are limited to the by-construction audit guarantee, store-dependent partial correction discrimination, and a benchmark- and model-specific failure of token-probability gating; scaling the fact base is required before human evaluation.

[NLP-162] Bridging the Gap: Converting Read Text to Conversational Dialogue

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决将朗读式语音（read speech）转换为自然对话式语音（conversational speech）时，如何在保持语音自然度与可懂度的同时，降低计算开销以满足实时应用需求的问题。其核心挑战在于朗读式语音普遍缺乏自然对话中所需的韵律多样性，如语调、重音和节奏的细微变化，从而影响虚拟助手、客户服务及语言学习等场景的交互体验。本文提出的解决方案——基于对话上下文的韵律调整（Prosodic Adjustment with Conversational Context, PACC），关键在于利用高保真生成对抗网络（HiFi-GAN）结合深度神经网络对语音的韵律特征进行精准分析与重构，通过引入对话上下文信息动态调节语调、重音与节奏模式，实现更自然流畅的语音转换。实验结果表明，该方法在提升语音自然度和模型准确性方面显著优于传统方法，并在平均意见分（MOS）评估中建立了新的基准，验证了其在多种语音转换任务中的可扩展性与有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18001
作者: Parshav Singla,Agnik Banerjee,Aaditya Arora,Shruti Aggarwal,Anil Kumar Verma,Vikram C M,Raj Prakash Gohil,Gopal Kumar Agarwal
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Sound (cs.SD); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)
备注: 11 pages, 4 figures. Published in ICICC 2025, Springer Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In recent advancements within speech processing, converting read speech to conversational speech has gained significant attention. The primary challenge in this domain is maintaining naturalness and intelligibility while minimizing computational overhead for real-time applications. Traditional read speech often lacks the nuanced prosodic variation essential for natural conversational interactions, posing challenges for applications in virtual assistants, customer service, and language learning tools. This paper introduces a novel approach, Prosodic Adjustment with Conversational Context (PACC), aimed at converting read speech into natural conversational speech used in various modern applications. PACC utilizes advanced deep neural networks to analyze and modify prosodic features such as intonation, stress, and rhythm. Unlike conventional methods, our approach uses High-Fidelity Generative Adversarial Networks (HiFi-GAN) for speech synthesis. Our experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in speech conversion, enhancing naturalness and achieving better model accuracy with additional training on speech datasets. This research establishes new benchmarks in speech conversion tasks and Mean Opinion Score (MOS) evaluation for testing model accuracy, and we show that our approach can be successfully extended to other speech conversion applications.

[NLP-163] MagiC: Evaluating Multimodal Cognition Toward Grounded Visual Reasoning AACL2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大型视觉-语言模型在视觉问答与多模态推理任务中是否存在真正意义上的“具身化视觉推理”（grounded visual reasoning）的问题，而非仅依赖表面模式或数据集偏差进行推断。其核心挑战在于如何有效评估模型是否能够基于真实视觉证据进行逻辑连贯、可解释且与图像内容高度对齐的推理过程。解决方案的关键在于提出MagiC这一综合性基准测试体系，通过约5,500个弱监督生成的问答样本和900个由人工精标的数据集，涵盖答案、推理链及边界框标注（bounding box groundings），全面评估模型在最终答案正确性、推理有效性、具身一致性（grounding fidelity）以及自我修正能力四个维度的表现。此外，研究引入诊断性设置以检验模型在对抗性视觉线索下的鲁棒性，并提出MagiScore与StepSense等新指标，系统揭示现有方法在具身化多模态认知中的关键局限与优化方向。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.07297
作者: Chengfei Wu,Ronald Seoh,Bingxuan Li,Liqiang Zhang,Fengrong Han,Dan Goldwasser
机构: Purdue University (普渡大学); University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (伊利诺伊大学厄本那-香槟分校); University of Connecticut (康涅狄格大学); University of California Berkeley (加州大学伯克利分校)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: AACL 2026 Main Conference

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent advances in large vision-language models have led to impressive performance in visual question answering and multimodal reasoning. However, it remains unclear whether these models genuinely perform grounded visual reasoning or rely on superficial patterns and dataset biases. In this work, we introduce MagiC, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate grounded multimodal cognition, assessing not only answer accuracy but also the quality of step-by-step reasoning and its alignment with relevant visual evidence. Our benchmark includes approximately 5,500 weakly supervised QA examples generated from strong model outputs and 900 human-curated examples with fine-grained annotations, including answers, rationales, and bounding box groundings. We evaluate 15 vision-language models ranging from 7B to 70B parameters across four dimensions: final answer correctness, reasoning validity, grounding fidelity, and self-correction ability. MagiC further includes diagnostic settings to probe model robustness under adversarial visual cues and assess their capacity for introspective error correction. We introduce new metrics such as MagiScore and StepSense, and provide comprehensive analyses that reveal key limitations and opportunities in current approaches to grounded visual reasoning.

Abstract:Large language models have exhibited significant enhancements in performance across various tasks. However, the complexity of their evaluation increases as these models generate more fluent and coherent content. Current multilingual benchmarks often use translated English versions, which may incorporate Western cultural biases that do not accurately assess other languages and cultures. To address this research gap, we introduce KULTURE Bench, an evaluation framework specifically designed for Korean culture that features datasets of cultural news, idioms, and poetry. It is designed to assess language models’ cultural comprehension and reasoning capabilities at the word, sentence, and paragraph levels. 【速读】： 该论文旨在解决雷特综合征（Rett syndrome）患者在真实世界中使用托芬奈特（trofinetide）治疗后，缺乏可扩展的疗效与不良反应监测方法的问题。由于传统病历回顾方式耗时费力，难以实现大规模数据提取。为此，研究提出了一种双大语言模型（large language model, LLM）共识管道，通过两阶段模型协同判断实现对18项治疗应答表型（包括4种不良反应、13种雷特综合征临床特征及药物拒绝行为）的自动化提取。其核心解决方案在于采用基于上下文学习（in-context learning）的提示工程（prompt engineering）与共识架构设计：首先在腹泻发生情况的数据集上优化模型架构与提示模板，随后将固定后的系统应用于其余17个表型，仅替换表型定义即可完成外样本测试。结果显示，要求“腹泻处于活跃且严重状态”的提示性能最优（准确率84.2±0.0%，F1=0.674），显著优于传统正则表达式匹配方法（提升47个百分点，p<0.0001）。专家评审对每种表型随机抽取6个标注结果进行验证，总体一致性达90.2%（92/102），证明了该方法的可靠性。值得注意的是，13项雷特综合征临床特征为疾病固有表现，并非药物所致不良反应；其中粗大运动障碍、精细运动障碍、语言/交流能力受损及刻板行为在所有随访时间点均在92%-100%的患者中被记录。研究结论表明，结合上下文推理与共识机制的大语言模型框架，可作为关键词与正则表达式提取的可扩展替代方案，仅通过配置调整即可适应新表型和新药物，为真实世界证据生成提供高效、灵活的技术路径。

Abstract:Objective: Trofinetide, approved in 2023 as the first Rett syndrome treatment, lacks scalable real-world monitoring because chart review is labor-intensive. We developed a dual large language model (LLM) consensus pipeline to extract 18 treatment-response phenotypes, comprising 4 adverse effects, 13 Rett clinical features, and medication refusal, from clinical notes. Materials and Methods: We analyzed 26,763 notes from 108 patients with confirmed sustained trofinetide exposure at Texas Children’s Hospital. The pipeline filters notes by keyword, classifies each through two LLMs requiring consensus, and aggregates a patient-by-timepoint matrix. Architecture and prompt were selected on a diarrhea development set, then frozen and applied to the other 17 phenotypes with the phenotype definition substituted, as an out-of-sample test. The reported prompt comparison scores 183 expert-labeled cells. Results: A prompt requiring diarrhea to be active and severe performed best (84.2 \pm 0.0% accuracy; F1 = 0.674), 47 percentage points above regular-expression matching ( p 0.0001 ). Expert reviewers judged six of the pipeline’s calls per phenotype, three positive and three negative, and agreed with 90.2% (92/102). The 13 Rett clinical features are manifestations of the disorder itself rather than adverse effects of trofinetide. Gross and fine motor impairment, language/communication, and stereotypy were documented present in 92-100% of patients at every visit. Discussion: In-context LLM extraction captured multi-domain treatment responses. The outcome is documented presence at each visit, not a direction-of-change judgment. Conclusion: Coupling in-context LLM reasoning with a consensus architecture offers a scalable alternative to keyword and regular-expression extraction for real-world evidence, adapting to new phenotypes and medications through configuration alone.

[NLP-166] When Does “Post-Call” Begin? An Availability Contract for Earnings-Call NLP Benchmarks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决企业财务信息披露在时间维度上的动态性所导致的模型预测中“事件内时序错配”（within-event timing mismatch）问题，即模型用于预测的文本或语音输入尚未完整时，目标变量（如股价收益）已开始计算，从而引发偏差。其核心解决方案是提出“可用性契约”（Availability Contract），明确界定输入边界、输入可得性证据、结果起始时间及基于该证据所能支持的主张。通过在24家公司的552场业绩说明会数据上应用该框架，研究发现：以电话会开始时刻为代理指标与以重构音频结束时刻加处理预留时间作为完成代理指标相比，有9.4%的通话导致收益符号反转；固定完成时间点后，28.3%的通话在收益分位数上发生改变。此外，在独立的公开波动率基准分析中，将事前目标窗口提前一个交易日会导致三日均方误差上升18.1%-21.4%，而模型排名保持不变。这表明尽管模型排序看似稳定，但标签和损失函数仍显著依赖于所声明的结果时钟设定。该契约机制使这一隐含假设显性化，并确保预测结论严格基于实际可得的时间证据。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21659
作者: Xiaoyu Ma,Kelvin J.L. Koa,Yuncong Liu,Ke-Wei Huang
机构: National University of Singapore, Asian Institute of Digital Finance (新加坡国立大学数字金融研究院)
类目: Computational Finance (q-fin.CP); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: ICAIF 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Corporate financial disclosures often unfold over time, with announcements, prepared remarks, and discussion spanning multiple high-frequency return intervals. Financial NLP benchmarks can therefore suffer from a within-event timing mismatch when the prediction target begins before the textual or audio input used by a model could be complete. Chronological train–test splits do not prevent this mismatch, because it occurs inside individual events rather than across samples. We introduce an Availability Contract, which requires a benchmark to state the input boundary, evidence for input availability, the outcome start, and the claims supported by that evidence. We apply this framework to 552 earnings calls from 24 firms. For each call, we hold the return endpoint fixed and compare the previous close, a documentary call-start proxy, and a completion proxy based on reconstructed audio end plus a stipulated processing allowance. At this baseline, moving from the call-start proxy to the completion proxy flips return signs for 9.4% of calls. Holding completion-clock cutpoints fixed, 28.3% change quintile. In an independent release-session analysis of a public earnings-call volatility benchmark, shifting before-market target windows forward by one trading session raises three-day mean squared error by 18.1-21.4% across four frozen prediction streams, while their point rankings remain unchanged. Together, the results show that labels and losses can depend materially on the declared outcome clock even when model rankings appear stable. The Availability Contract makes this assumption explicit and ties post-input claims to the available timing evidence.

[IR-0] CARA: Causally Guided Retrieval Agent for Question Answering

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22017
作者: Weicheng Liu,Xiangcheng Wu,Depeng Xu,Haopeng Zhang,Xi Niu
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注: 16 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Retrieval-augmented generation over text-rich knowledge graphs requires identifying evidence that contributes to answering a question, rather than merely matching its textual content. Existing agentic retrievers adaptively balance global search and multi-hop exploration but primarily rely on textual similarity to guide retrieval. We propose CARA, a training-free, CAusally guided Retrieval Agent that explicitly evaluates the causal relevance of retrieved evidence through two complementary criteria: consequentiality, measuring whether adding evidence improves answerability, and essentiality, assessing whether removing evidence weakens answerability. CARA integrates these assessments with path consistency to guide graph exploration and employs reciprocal rank fusion to aggregate evidence from multiple agents. We evaluate CARA on three STaRK datasets and augment STaRK with ground-truth answers to enable downstream question answering evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that CARA consistently outperforms existing retrievers. CARA also improves answer quality and faithfulness while examining fewer graph nodes and requiring fewer retrieval operations. These findings demonstrate that causal relevance assessment enables more focused and effective agentic graph retrieval, improving both retrieval performance and downstream question answering.

Abstract:Context compression in long-running applications of large language models (LLMs) must preserve goal-relevant information, often before specific downstream questions are known. We introduce GACC-Bench, a benchmark for Goal-Adaptive Context Compression that evaluates how reliably LLMs adapt information retention to specified high-level goals. For each source context, we derive one or more high-level goals by grouping source-grounded questions according to shared downstream objectives. The benchmark contains 500 goals and 2,571 questions over 281 document and agent-trace contexts from seven collections spanning diverse domains, with all instances reviewed by human experts. The compressor receives a source context, a goal, and a context-length budget, with the associated evaluation questions withheld. A fixed reader answers these questions individually using the same compressed context. Our evaluation of ten LLM compressors reveals substantial gaps to full-context performance even for the best-performing model, particularly in supporting correct answers to every question associated with a goal. Compared with goal-agnostic compression, target-goal conditioning consistently improves accuracy, whereas mismatched-goal conditioning reduces it. GACC-Bench is available at this https URL.

[IR-2] Aligning LLM s with Sparse Retrieval via Adaptive Sparse Supervision

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21877
作者: Tongna Chen,Minghan Li,Guodong Zhou
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:While large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic representations, their application to first-stage retrieval incurs substantial latency and storage costs. Neural sparse retrievers such as SPLADE provide efficient retrieval but rely on relatively compact encoders with limited representational capacity. To bridge this gap, we propose an LLM-based sparse retrieval framework with input-adaptive sparse alignment. Specifically, we introduce a dynamic \alpha -truncation strategy that selects input-specific supervision supports based on the cumulative activation mass of SPLADE representations. This strategy guides the LLM to preserve salient lexical signals while suppressing less informative activations, without relying on a fixed support budget. Subsequent retrieval fine-tuning combines contrastive learning, knowledge distillation, and sparsity regularization to improve retrieval effectiveness. Experiments on MS MARCO and six selected BEIR datasets demonstrate improvements over SPLADE++ while maintaining competitive effectiveness against LLM-based sparse retrievers. Compared with Lion-sp, our method reduces index storage by 6.4-fold and end-to-end query latency by over 11-fold, achieving a favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off.

[IR-3] Retrieved but Not Read: Understanding Why Search-Augmented LLM s Fail to Use Available Evidence ALT

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21731
作者: Owen Walters,Lihu Chen,Francesca Toni
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注: 14 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Web search allows LLMs to access up-to-date information, but it remains unclear why they sometimes produce outdated answers even when relevant evidence is available. To study this problem, we construct temporal facts whose values changed after the models’ training cutoffs. We evaluate one proprietary model under deployed web search and six open-weight model configurations under controlled retrieval. We find that models often answer from search snippets without opening the source pages, which is associated with higher rates of outdated answers and unfaithful citations. Our controlled experiments and layer-wise analysis reveal a gap between the availability of evidence and its effective use. Even when retrieved evidence influences internal predictions, models may still favour outdated information in their final answers. We hope these findings will help advance research on the reliable use of retrieved evidence in search-augmented LLMs.

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for election information, yet little is known about how external web content shapes the political information they present. Generative engine optimization (GEO) rewrites web content to improve its visibility in generated responses. To investigate its potential risks in voting scenarios (VoteGEO), we introduce VoteGEO-Bench, a benchmark covering the 2024 U.S. presidential election and the 2026 Japanese House of Representatives election, combining election-related queries, historical webpages, and voter personas. We first analyze sources cited by generative engines and find that many citations come from lower-cost owned and open-platform sources, while some webpages remain visible across days. We then evaluate 11 rewriting strategies in 4 categories, examining target specification, effectiveness across engines and elections, and the role of voter personas. Rewriting without specifying a target rarely increases target exposure, whereas target-specified rewriting more often does. Strategies that improve page organization or strengthen a position through argumentation yield greater gains than adding supporting evidence or changing wording. For the two strongest strategies, gains remain broadly positive across evaluated U.S. personas, but persona conditioning shows no consistent effect on these gains. Explicit partisan identities can create baseline exposure gaps larger than the gain from rewriting one webpage. When partisanship is implicit in the voter profile, baseline shifts depend on how strongly the engine responds to that signal.

点击查看摘要

Abstract:To show that a medical device complies with regulation, experts judge whether documents and records meet each requirement and record the judgment for others to verify. For each assessment item that experts define, large language models could prepare a preliminary assessment: a label such as Satisfied or Not satisfied, a reason and quoted evidence. We sent fourteen commercial deployments of such models (seven models from three providers, through six routes) the same request repeatedly, with the deterministic sampling settings each accepted; every deployment returned differing assessments for at least one request, and in twelve the label changed. Reducing reasoning where the interface allows it did not reduce the variation, and prompts of retrieved passages removed it only for the smallest models. The same open-weight model was reproducible or not depending only on how it was served. A pipeline we built to be deterministic at every stage – text extraction and optical character recognition (OCR), chunking, embedding, indexing, retrieval and inference – returned byte-identical output at each stage across reruns, interruptions, edits, machines of one graphics processing unit (GPU) model and days, for blood glucose meter and infusion pump documents. OCR, embedding and approximate retrieval varied when their own serving was not made invariant, and outputs changed with the GPU model and with the inference engine’s scheduling settings, which therefore belong in the recorded configuration. End-to-end determinism is achievable and gives a testable basis for audit and change control.

Abstract:Modern agents select tools from registries, but exposing entire registries incurs high token costs and can impair selection as they grow. We present TRACER, a retrieval front-end that indexes observed tool-call sequences in a trie and ranks continuations using a learned blend of empirical and contextual priors. 点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recommender systems often need to balance multiple conflicting objectives. Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation (CMOR) enables dynamic adjustment of objective trade-offs at inference time without retraining, adapting to shifting user or system requirements. Existing CMOR approaches typically rely on output-level reranking or parameter-generating modules, which either limit the scope of feasible trade-offs or incur substantial training and inference cost. Model merging provides a promising alternative by reusing multiple objective-specific models via parameter combination. However, its direct application to recommender systems is challenging due to the lack of a shared linear regime and cross-objective interference. To address these issues, we propose RecSoup, a lightweight two-stage approach for effective CMOR via specialized model merging. RecSoup first mitigates parameter interference across objectives through a pruning strategy that jointly considers objective-specific importance and cross-objective relevance. It then performs adaptive parameter merging via a learnable preference-to-coefficient mapping, allowing dynamic trade-off control at inference time without joint retraining or additional generative modules. Theoretically, we prove that RecSoup outperforms the parameter generation paradigm in effectiveness and efficiency, as it can fully navigate the Pareto front without smoothness constraints. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that RecSoup achieves improved Pareto front quality and effective controllability while delivers 165–228x faster inference-time latency than parameter generation approaches. Abstract:Reasoning-conditioned embeddings can improve retrieval by progressively refining semantic constraints. However, additional reasoning may introduce over-generalized or semantically noisy abstractions that weaken retrieval specificity. Existing methods largely supervise reasoning through final retrieval outcomes, providing limited guidance over the refinement process itself. We propose AURA, a framework that directly supervises intermediate reasoning states according to how well they separate relevant documents from hard distractors. AURA further trains a lightweight utility estimator over prefix-conditioned embeddings to adapt reasoning depth at inference time. On the reasoning-intensive BRIGHT benchmark, AURA-4B achieves 34.7 average nDCG@10 while using 2.8 reasoning steps and 96 generated tokens per query. Under matched deployment conditions, adaptive stopping reduces latency from 4.6 to 0.76 seconds relative to full-trajectory reasoning. Results on MS MARCO further suggest that this specialization need not substantially degrade conventional in-domain retrieval.

Abstract:We present TransX, a sequence-transduction framework and co-designed infrastructure for scaling industrial recommendation with explicit control over model-compute allocation and execution amortization. TransX separates sequence encoding, behavior memory, and candidate-conditioned fusion into independently scalable components. Training amortizes causal trajectory computation across behavioral prefixes and fans out memory states to candidates; serving disaggregates bulk prefill, nearline refresh, and online prediction through compact behavior-memory KV. We observe anisotropic scaling returns: encoder scaling may saturate beyond moderate depth at fixed memory resolution and fusion capacity; increasing supervision shifts the allocation frontier toward candidate-conditioned fusion; and the memory resolution needed to preserve quality remains roughly stable as model capacity grows. We train TransX on click and conversion, post-train its shared behavioral interface for retrieval and preference ranking, and explore generative recommendation offline. In separate production A/B experiments, the core TransX model improves CTR by 6.02% and conversion by 4.45%, while post-trained retrieval and preference-ranking variants improve CTR by 2.96% and conversion by 1.33%, respectively, over corresponding production baselines. Under matched training conditions, the training infrastructure increases supervised-target throughput by 84%. In serving, disaggregation reduces TransX’s total serving cost by nearly 80% versus colocated serving at matched traffic and SLO, enabling approximately 5X the per-request model FLOPs of the HSTU-style production baseline at the same total serving cost. At matched per-request model FLOPs, TransX delivers approximately 4X higher request throughput per H200. These results show that online serving cost need not grow proportionally with recommendation model capacity. Abstract:On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as a promising approach for transferring the capabilities of large agents to compact students. In deep search, where agents iteratively retrieve external evidence, a teacher’s preference among plausible queries before retrieval may not predict which queries will return useful evidence. Standard OPD nevertheless supervises each student query from the preceding context alone, inducing a failure mode we term \textbf\textitevidence-blind supervision (EBS). To understand this, we regroup the OPD objective by interaction turns and reveal two implicit priors: a \textitbudget prior that allocates supervision by token volume, and a \textitdirection prior that favors tokens preferred by the teacher, neither of which accounts for the evidence returned by the current query. Our empirical analysis shows that both priors contribute to EBS in practice: the first search turn accounts for 51.1% of total absolute information gain but receives only 18.0% of the supervision budget, while 43.7% of search queries have teacher rewards that disagree in sign with post-retrieval information utility. To mitigate this, we propose \ours, which uses post-retrieval information gain (IG) to calibrate both priors: reallocating supervision toward information-critical turns while calibrating query preferences using the utility of retrieved evidence. Experiments on six multimodal search benchmarks show that \ours improves average accuracy by 3.4 and 1.7 percentage points for 2B and 4B students over standard OPD, enabling the 4B student to surpass its 8B teacher on MMSearch and BrowseComp-VL.

[HC-0] Asking Smarter Questions: Targeted Active Preference Learning for Underspecified Rewards

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22285
作者: Helena Merker,Nick Walker,Andreea Bobu
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026), Austin, TX. 18 pages, 8 figures, 1 table

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reward learning typically assumes the human’s input covers everything that matters for the task. In practice, humans can only attend to so much at once, so their teaching naturally captures some features—or aspects of the task—better than others. Prior work has shown how the robot can identify which features were poorly supervised directly from its teaching data. But the current solution is to ask the human to try again, putting the burden on someone who already struggled to convey those features. We propose shifting this burden to the robot. Our key insight is that the same information that tells the robot what it doesn’t know can help it ask better questions. Preference queries offer a low-effort channel for resolving this uncertainty, but only if the robot knows where to direct them and the human knows what to attend to when answering. We act on this insight in two ways: we build an informed prior that targets preference queries at the features that need resolving, and we accompany each query with an explanation that focuses the human’s attention on exactly those features. In simulation, the informed prior beats the standard active preference learning baseline by up to 30.8% in the low-query regime, where reducing human effort matters most. In a user study, the informed prior and explanations each significantly improve reward recovery and amplify each other.

Abstract:LLM-powered agents increasingly support open-ended activities, yet orchestrating when and how agents interact with humans remains challenging. Existing approaches often provide interaction mechanisms tied to particular tasks or execution patterns, lacking a unified architecture for diverse and evolving interaction needs. We introduce Inflak, a unified four-layer architecture for human-agent interaction orchestration that separates state reconstruction and routing, interaction and execution planning, interaction design, and interface rendering. Its layered design with progressive resolution enables general applicability, runtime flexibility, module composability, and orchestration maintainability. We implement Inflak as agent-native, skill-based plugins within a general-purpose agent framework and evaluate it through a gallery of various application scenarios and interaction paradigms, technical performance testing, and a comparative implementation case study. The evaluations show that Inflak can serve as a general and extensible foundation for orchestrating diverse human-agent interaction flows.

Abstract:This paper investigates user interaction with digital displays in self-service restaurant environments, focusing on the phenomenon where users often settle for good enough interactions rather than optimal. We apply bounded rationality theory to understand how cognitive limitations influence user decisions to engage with displays of varying interaction complexity. Through analysis of two field experiments conducted at a self-service restaurant in Finland, we examine interactive displays that require different levels of cognitive investment: a simple binary choice interface and a multi-step interaction. Our initial findings suggest an “engagement plateau” where increased interaction complexity yields diminishing returns in initial engagement rates, yet users who overcome initial cognitive barriers demonstrate high completion rates. This work contributes to Human-Computer Interaction field by offering an empirically supported theoretical lens for understanding user behavior in Self-Service Restaurant (SSR) environments and providing actionable design principles for public interactive displays that accommodate human cognitive limits.
